Description.SourceString: 鉴别等级是「异能者·零」所特有的「第零感」感知力的等级，左右着遭遇与发现。敌人强度和掉落奖励都将随鉴别等级的提高而提高。当猎人等级到达10/20/30/40/45/50/55级后，会对应提升1级鉴别等级。
Description.LocalizedString: The Appraisal Level is the level of Zeroth Sense, the perception unique to Esper Zero. This determines Esper Zero's encounters and discoveries in Hethereau. Enemy power and drops will increase with the Appraisal Level. When the Hunter Level reaches 10/20/30/40/45/50/55, the Appraisal Level will increase by 1.

Description.SourceString: 猎人等级达到特定阶段后，需要完成<red>突破任务</>，以提升<red>猎人等级上限</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Complete <red>Ascension Quests</> after reaching certain Hunter Level milestones to increase your <red>Hunter Level Limit</>.

Description.SourceString: 积累猎人经验可以提升猎人等级，并解锁更多的任务与玩法。通过以下途径可以快速获得猎人经验：完成<red>每日活跃目标</>、<red>消耗本性像素</>、<red>完成任务</>，以及<red>探索</>完成城市中的玩法。
Description.LocalizedString: Accumulating Hunter EXP increases your Hunter Level and unlocks more Quests and Modes. Earn Hunter EXP quickly by completing <red>Daily Objectives</>, <red>spending Character Pixels</>, <red>completing Quests</>, and <red>City Exploration</>

Description.SourceString: 猎人等级提升后，可领取对应等级的奖励。
Description.LocalizedString: You can claim rewards corresponding to your Hunter Level after it increases.

Description.SourceString: 每名角色对应一组专属形状的<red>空幕</>，鉴定师可在其中放置<red>卡带</>与<red>驱动块</>，以增强使用者的属性。
Description.LocalizedString: Each character has a uniquely shaped <red>Console</>, where the Appraiser can place <red>Cartridges</> and <red>Modules</> to enhance the wearer's attributes.

Description.SourceString: <red>卡带</>可赋予角色多种特殊能力，若空幕中同时放置了卡带所需的<red>驱动块</>，还能激活其<red>进阶效果</>。
Description.LocalizedString: <red>Cartridges</> grant characters special abilities. Placing the required <red>Modules</> in the <red>Console</> can activate <red>Advanced Effects</>.

Description.SourceString: <red>驱动块</>可为角色提供基础属性加成，放置时需对应<red>空幕</>中的空缺形状进行嵌合。
Description.LocalizedString: <red>Modules</> provide Basic Attribute bonuses and must be fitted into the corresponding empty shapes in the <red>Console</>.

Description.SourceString: 使用在异象界域<red>「兔子洞」</>中获得的<red>萝卜币</>，可进行<red>倒带</>操作，以获取各类<red>驱动块</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Use <red>Carrota</> earned in the Anomaly Zone <red>Rabbit Hole</> to perform <red>rewind</> operations and obtain various <red>Modules</>.

Description.SourceString: 玩家可通过向已结识的角色<red>赠送礼物</>来提升好感度等级。每次好感度提升，都可能会解锁<red>专属消息</>与<red>特殊事件</>。完成这些事件后，可进一步提升好感度等级。随着好感度不断提高，还将解锁<red>限定礼物</>作为奖励。
Description.LocalizedString: Players can increase Affection levels by <red>giving gifts</> to characters they've met. Each Affection increase may unlock <red>Exclusive Messages</> and <red>Special Encounters</>. Completing these encounters further increases Affection levels. As Affection grows, you'll also unlock <red>limited gifts</> as rewards.

Description.SourceString: 在城市中，无论是偶遇异象，还是接受相关委托，鉴定师都有可能遭遇强大的异象敌人。部分异象在被击败后会留下「异象残留物」，鉴定师可对其进行捕获变为可装备的弧盘。
Description.LocalizedString: Throughout the city, whether encountering Anomalies by chance or accepting related Commissions, you may face powerful Anomalies. Some may leave behind Anomaly Residual after being defeated, which you can capture and craft into equipable Arcs.

Description.SourceString: 通过<red>强化</>与<red>混频</>，可提升弧盘的各项属性，有效增强使用者的属性。
Description.LocalizedString: You can improve an Arc's attributes through <red>Enhancing</> and <red>Mixing</>, effectively boosting the wearer's stats.

Description.SourceString: 加入怪人们的艺术派对吧，世界属于叉叉派！击败怪人后，可消耗本性像素，兑换各类<red>角色</>、<red>弧盘</>与<red>空幕</>的<red>培养材料</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Join the strangers' art party! The world belongs to us! After defeating strangers, you can spend Character Pixels to exchange for various <red>upgrade materials</> for <red>Characters</>, <red>Arcs</>, and <red>Consoles</>.

Description.SourceString:
与强敌交战的记忆仍历历在目——不如就此启程，开启圣地巡礼！
击败强大的异象，将可获得<red>角色异能</>提升所需的<red>珍稀材料</>。
Description.LocalizedString:
The memories of battling powerful foes are still vivid—why not set forth and begin a pilgrimage to sacred sites!
Defeating powerful Anomalies will grant you <red>rare materials</> needed to enhance <red>Character Esper Abilities</>.

Description.SourceString:
城市中潜藏着一条神秘的地铁线路——<red>轨外之境</>。其路径常年变动，无人知晓终点通往何方。
鉴定师可在异象车站搭乘<red>幽灵号</>列车，挑战每一站潜伏的强大异象。若能在特定条件下击败敌人，即可获得<red>丰厚奖励</>。
Description.LocalizedString:
Hidden within the city lies a mysterious subway line—<red>Beyond the Rails</>. Its route constantly shifts, and no one knows where its final destination leads.
The Appraiser can board the <red>Ghost Train</> at anomaly stations to challenge the powerful anomalies lurking at each stop. Defeat enemies under specific conditions to earn <red>generous rewards</>.

Description.SourceString:
轨外之境中分布着多条神秘<red>线路</>，每条线路皆由多个<red>站台</>组成。
每座站台皆潜藏着强大的异象，鉴定师唯有击败当前站台的异象，方可搭乘幽灵号列车，前往下一站的未知挑战。
Description.LocalizedString:
Beyond the Rails contains multiple mysterious <red>routes</>, each composed of several <red>stations</>.
Every station harbors powerful anomalies, and the Appraiser can only board the Ghost Train to proceed to the next station's unknown challenges after defeating the anomaly at the current station.

Description.SourceString: 鉴定师可使用在<red>轨外之境</>挑战中获得的<red>幽灵羽毛</>，在<red>异境补给站</>兑换各类具特殊效果的强化道具，并在轨外之境探索过程中使用这些道具提升战力。
Description.LocalizedString: The Appraiser can use <red>Ghost Feathers</> earned from <red>Beyond the Rails</> challenges to exchange for various enhancement items with special effects at the <red>Otherworld Supply Stop</>, and use these items during Beyond the Rails exploration to boost combat power.

Description.SourceString: 城市里每天会出现不同的送货委托，玩家可以依据<red>货物类型、送货时间、路线、委托报酬</>等信息，来到指定地点接取委托。依据送货情况，玩家可以获得不同的专业评分，评分越高，赚取的报酬也就越高！
Description.LocalizedString: Different delivery commissions appear daily throughout the city. Players can review <red>cargo type, delivery time, route, and the commission reward</> info before heading to designated locations to accept commissions. Based on delivery performance, players can earn different professional ratings—the higher the rating, the greater the reward!

Description.SourceString: 当<red>「通缉值」</>累计至一定程度时，城市治安部队将前来逮捕鉴定师并处以罚款。若拒绝缴纳罚款，鉴定师将进入<red>「监管状态」</>。进入监管状态后，界面左侧将显示对应提示，直至监管结束。
Description.LocalizedString: When <red>warrant</> accumulates to a certain level, the city's security forces will come to arrest the Appraiser and impose a fine. If the Appraiser refuses to pay the fine, they will be given <red>Parole</>. Once in Parole, a corresponding notification will appear on the left side of the interface until Parole ends.

Description.SourceString: 在监管状态下，鉴定师的部分行为将受到限制，直至监管时间结束。
Description.LocalizedString: While in Parole, some of the Appraiser's actions will be restricted until the Parole time ends.

Description.SourceString: 消耗「捏造骰子」或「质实骰子」获得当前移动点数，移动至对应格子内并获得道具。
Description.LocalizedString: Consume Fabricated Dice or Solid Dice to gain movement points, then move to the corresponding tile and obtain items.

Description.SourceString: 移动至「于此同行」格子内，必定获得当前格子内所示角色。
Description.LocalizedString: Landing on a Journey Together tile guarantees the character shown on that tile.

Description.SourceString:
当操纵角色移动至宝箱格中，根据宝箱类型不同有机会直接获得当前棋盘内S级角色。
<red>「学徒宝箱」</>
有0.2%基础概率直接获得当前棋盘内S级角色，有99.8%的基础概率获得B级弧盘。
<Orange>「勇者宝箱」</>
必定获得2个失纬棋子，有3%基础概率直接获得当前棋盘内S级角色，有97%的基础概率获得B级弧盘。
Description.LocalizedString:
When moving your character to a Chest Tile, you have a chance to immediately obtain S-Class Characters from the current board depending on the chest type.
<red>Apprentice Chest</>
0.2% base chance to immediately obtain S-Class Character from current board, 99.8% base chance to obtain B-Class Arc.
<Orange>Hero Chest</>
Guaranteed 2 Warp Pieces, 3% base chance to immediately obtain S-Class Character from current board, 97% base chance to obtain B-Class Arc.

Description.SourceString: 棋盘上存在休憩中的<red>宝藏守护者</>，当移动至该格子内时将唤醒沉睡的守护者，它会带着宝藏<red>向前逃跑9格</>，需要在<red>3次</>掷骰内追上守护者，每次掷骰后守护者将<red>向前移动2格</>，成功追上守护者可获得<red>30个失纬棋子</>，失败则守护者带着宝藏消失。
Description.LocalizedString: There are resting <red>Guardians</> on the board. When you move to their tile, you will awaken the dormant Guardian, who will <red>flee forward 9 tiles</> with the treasure. You need to catch up to the guardian within <red>3</> dice rolls. After each dice roll, the Guardian will <red>move forward 2 tiles</>. Successfully catching the guardian rewards <red>30 Warp Pieces</>, while failure causes the Guardian to disappear with the treasure.

GuideName.SourceString: 斯卡布罗集市·彩虹引桥和隐藏集市
GuideName.LocalizedString: Scarborough Fair - Rainbow Bridge & Secret Fair

Description.SourceString: <red>隐藏集市</>需要通过<red>虹色引桥</>到达，隐藏集市内的奖励道具更加丰厚。
Description.LocalizedString: <red>The Secret Fair</> can only be reached through the <red>Rainbow Bridge</>. The rewards are greater within the Secret Fair.

GuideName.SourceString: 斯卡布罗集市·棋盘变格

Description.SourceString:
当通过掷骰在本期限定棋盘中获得非S级道具时，将获得1点<red>「印迹」</>，当累计获得70点印迹时，将触发<red>「棋盘变格」</>，棋盘发生变化，部分格子内稀有道具和角色的获取概率提升。
所有「学徒宝箱」升级为「勇者宝箱」，「勇者宝箱」替换为「于此同行」。
Description.LocalizedString:
当通过掷骰在本期限定棋盘中获得非S级道具时，将获得1点<red>「印迹」</>，当累计获得70点印迹时，将触发<red>「棋盘变格」</>，棋盘发生变化，部分格子内稀有道具和角色的获取概率提升。
所有「学徒宝箱」升级为「勇者宝箱」，「勇者宝箱」替换为「于此同行」。

GuideName.SourceString: 斯卡布罗集市·集点馈谢

Description.SourceString: 当通过掷骰在本期限定棋盘中获得非S级道具时，将获得1点<red>「印迹」</>，当累计获得<red>89点</>印迹时，将触发<red>「集点馈谢」</>，下一次掷骰棋子不会移动，并直接获得当前棋盘内S级角色。
Description.LocalizedString: When obtaining non-S-Class items through dice rolls on the current limited board, you will gain 1 <red>Trace</>. When you accumulate <red>89</> Marks, <red>Points Reward</> will be triggered. On the next dice roll, your piece will not move and you will directly obtain an S-Class Character from the current board.

Description.SourceString:
每日只能在StarSign<red>非营业期间（3-15点）</>练习。
屏幕上方会不断下落音符点，根据音乐节奏在恰当时机点击<red>对应按键</>即可响应节奏点。歌曲结束后会根据节奏点响应的<red>准确度</>进行评分。
Description.LocalizedString:
Practice is only available daily during StarSign's <red>non-business hours (03:00–15:00)</>.
Notes will appear constantly at the top of the screen. <red>Press keys</> according to the music rhythm to respond to the rhythm points. After the song ends, you will be evaluated based on the <red>accuracy</> of your rhythm point responses.

Description.SourceString: 使用<red>D</>，<red>F</>，<red>J</>，<red>K</>可分别响应四个鼓面。
Description.LocalizedString: Use <red>D</>, <red>F</>, <red>J</>, and <red>K</> to hit the four drum pads.

Value.LocalizedString: Press to hit the four drum pads.

Description.SourceString: 当鉴定师靠近伊波恩房间内的床铺、维特海默塔或ReroRero电话亭时，受伤或失去意识的角色将自动恢复。
Description.LocalizedString: Approach a bed in Eibon's Room, Wertheimer Tower, or the ReroRero Phone Booth to automatically recover injured or unconscious characters.

Description.SourceString: 部分弧盘具有<red>调弧</>效果，鉴定师为角色装备后，可在战斗中使用。
Description.LocalizedString: Some Arcs have <red>Arc</> effects. Equip to a character to use these effects in battle.

Description.SourceString: 在移动过程中，鉴定师可以通过Ctrl键或轻推摇杆可以在<red>行走</>与<red>奔跑</>之间切换。
Description.LocalizedString: Use Ctrl or lightly push the analog stick to toggle between <red>walking</> and <red>running</> while moving.

Description.SourceString: 鉴定师可以在跳跃过程中再次使用<red>跳跃</>操作使用滑翔翼。
Description.LocalizedString: You can use <red>Jump</> again while mid-air to deploy the glider.

Description.SourceString: 鉴定师从高处坠落会受到坠落伤害。为避免角色受伤或失去意识，请及时使用滑翔翼。
Description.LocalizedString: You will take fall damage when falling from great heights. To prevent characters from getting injured or knocked out, deploy the glider in time.

Description.SourceString: 在<red>「都市大亨」</>中可查看并参与都市玩法。通过参与<red>都市玩法</>可提升都市大亨等级，而都市大亨等级的提升将进一步解锁并强化都市玩法相关的<red>权益</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Access and participate in City Modes through <red>City Tycoon</>. Participating in <red>City Modes</> increases your City Tycoon level, which unlocks and enhances <red>perks</> related to City Modes.

Description.SourceString: 若您想拥有一辆自己的车辆，可以前往<red>「新越」</>车行进行挑选。
Description.LocalizedString: If you want to own a vehicle, you can head to <red>Novus</> and shop for one.

Description.SourceString: 想在海特洛市拥有属于自己的房产，需要前往<red>「莱昂置业」</>购买。
Description.LocalizedString: To own property in Hethereau, visit <red>Leon Estate Group</>.

Description.SourceString: 街上在售的商铺均可购买并用来开设商店。您也可以去<red>「莱昂置业」</>选购商铺。购买商铺后，您可以调整店内的雇员与商品来增加收入。调整商品后，不要忘了添加原料库存哦！
Description.LocalizedString: Shops for sale can be purchased to open your own store. Visit <red>Leon Estate Group</> to buy shops, then find the right employees and items to increase your revenue. Remember to keep inventory too!

Description.SourceString:
1. 四人同局竞技的消除游戏，可选择<Red>「好友组队」</>或<Red>「在线匹配」</>两种模式。
2. 玩家需在各自的游玩区域中进行方块<Red>堆叠</>与<Red>消除</>。
3. 每次成功消除都会对其他所有玩家产生<Red>「攻击方块」</>，攻击方块会在一段时间后会变为<Red>「垃圾行」</>出现在其他玩家的游玩区域。
4. 玩家可通过<Red>「连续消除」</>与<Red>「特殊消除」</>等技巧来强化阶段内攻击方块的强度。
5. 对局结束时将产生<Red>一名胜利者</>，并根据<Red>最终排名</>获得对应奖励。
Description.LocalizedString:
1. A four-player competitive puzzle game. <Red>Team up with friends</> or <Red>match online</>.
2. Players can <Red>stack</> and <Red>clear</> blocks in their own play area.
3. Each successful clear sends <Red>attack blocks</> to all other players. After a short time, attack blocks turn into <Red>garbage rows</> in other players' play areas.
4. Use techniques like <Red>chain clears</> and <Red>special clears</> to increase the strength of attack blocks during each phase.
5. <Red>One winner</> is determined at the end of each match. Rewards are distributed based on <Red>final rankings</>.

Description.SourceString:
即将遭遇强大的敌人，最直接提升作战能力的方式是<red>提升角色等级</>。
除此之外鉴定师还可以为角色装备<red>弧盘</>、<red>空幕</>，对角色进行<red>异能提升</>和<red>觉醒</>，均可显著增加角色作战能力。
Description.LocalizedString:
Boost combat power by <red>leveling up</>.
Also equip <red>Arcs</> and <red>Consoles</>, upgrade <red>Esper Abilities</>, or <red>Awaken</> characters for major boosts.

Description.SourceString:
<red>弧盘</>主要为角色提供进攻型属性，提升角色造成的伤害。
部分弧盘还具有<red>调弧</>效果，调弧效果将为角色提供主动技能，增加作战的决策多样性。
Description.LocalizedString:
<red>Arcs</> increase damage.
Some may grant <red>Arc Effects</>, adding active skills and tactical options.

Description.SourceString: <red>空幕</>由<red>卡带</>和<red>驱动块</>组成，提供多种作战属性。玩家可以为<red>每名角色</>配置不同的卡带和驱动块，组合出最适配的属性方案。
Description.LocalizedString: <red>Consoles</> combine <red>Cartridges</> and <red>Modules</>. Mix and match to optimize <red>each character</>'s attributes.

Description.SourceString:
在<red>异能</>中可升级角色技能效果，包含<red>普通攻击</>、<red>变轨技能</>、<red>极轨终结</>、<red>援护技</>。升级后技能效果将获得强化，
包括<red>提升伤害倍率</>、<red>缩短冷却时间</>等，显著增强角色战斗能力。
Description.LocalizedString:
Upgrade <red>Esper Abilities</>—<red>Basic Attack</>, <red>Redirect Skill</>, <red>Ultimate</>, and <red>Support Skill</>.
Upgrades improve skill effectst like <red>increasing DMG Ratio</> or <red>cooldown reduction</>.

Description.SourceString: 当鉴定师多次获取角色时，可以对角色进行<red>觉醒</>，每次觉醒都将为角色提供跨越性的成长。
Description.LocalizedString: Acquire duplicates to <red>Awaken</> characters, granting significant growth and power boosts.

Description.SourceString: 当您拥有多辆载具时，可以在<red>背包</>中对其进行<red>快捷装备</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Multiple vehicles available. Configure them via <red>Inventory</> using <red>Quick Equip</>.

Description.SourceString: 装备后，您可以在主界面中，<red>长按道具栏快捷键</>，切换您配置的载具。
Description.LocalizedString: Equipped vehicles can be switched from the main screen by holding the <red>Item Bar shortcut</>.

Value.SourceString: 装备后，您可以在主界面中，<red>长按道具栏</>，切换您配置的载具。
Value.LocalizedString: Equipped vehicles can be switched from the main screen by holding the <red>Item Bar</>.

Value.SourceString: 装备后，您可以在主界面中，<red>长按道具栏</>，切换您配置的载具。
Value.LocalizedString: Equipped vehicles can be switched from the main screen by holding the <red>Item Bar</>.

Description.SourceString: 当您处于<red>第一人称</>视角时，可以在<red>设置</>中<red>切换第一人称/第三人称</>视角。
Description.LocalizedString: While in <red>First-Person View</>, you can <red>switch between first-person and third-person</> views in <red>Settings</>.

Description.SourceString: 请鉴定师用不同的视角欣赏海特洛的风貌吧。
Description.LocalizedString: Switch perspectives to explore Hethereau's scenery as the Appraiser.

Description.SourceString: 鉴定师可以在呗果上浏览其他玩家发布的帖子。
Description.LocalizedString: You can browse posts shared by other players on Bagel.

Description.SourceString: 鉴定师可从相册内选择图片发布帖子到呗果。通过审核后，其他玩家可以看到该帖子。
Description.LocalizedString: You can choose images from the album to create posts on Bagel. Once approved, these posts will be visible to other players.

Description.SourceString: 鉴定师可在创作中心查看自己的帖子<red>互动数据</>（包含浏览量、点赞以及收藏数等数据），互动数据将在<red>服务器每日0点更新</>。
Description.LocalizedString: You can view <red>engagement data</> for your posts in Creator Hub, including views, likes, saves, and more. Engagement data is updated daily at <red>00:00 server time</>.

Description.SourceString: 呗果开启<red>创作者激励计划</>，帖子互动数据将会按比例转化为<red>「过奖果酱」</>，可前往「呗果商店」兑换所需奖励。
Description.LocalizedString: Bagel has launched the <red>Creator Incentive Program</>. Post engagement data will be converted into <red>Praise Jams</> at a fixed rate. Praise Jams can be exchanged for rewards at Bagel Shop.

Description.SourceString:
不知前路、难以落地的盲目乌鸦衔着的宝石，无人知晓它们来自何方。
有传言说捡到「谕石」的人会被厄运缠身，倘若不小心捡到也不用在意，<red>位于各地「魔女之家」中的魔女小姐似乎正在收集这些「谕石」。</>如果将「谕石」交给她的话，她不仅能为你消弭这份厄运，还会有对应的酬劳作为答谢。
Description.LocalizedString:
Gems carried by blind ravens, lost and unable to land, their origins unknown to all.
Rumors say that those who pick up Oracle Stones will be struck by misfortune, but don't worry if you happen to find one—<red>The mysterious lady from the Witch's House is collecting these Oracle Stones.</> If you hand her your Oracle Stones, not only will they dispel your misfortune, but also provide rewards.

Description.SourceString: 欢迎来到<red>「魔女之家」</>，在这里可以将收集到的<red>「谕石」</>交给魔女小姐。若是陷入了迷茫，魔女小姐也会为你占卜运势，看清前路。
Description.LocalizedString: Welcome to <red>The Witch's House</>, where you can hand in <red>Oracle Stones</> to the witch. If you find yourself lost, the witch will also divine your luck and show you the road ahead.

Description.SourceString: 靠近「待收容异象」至一定距离后，小地图会自动开启雷达标识。当距离不断缩短，雷达的颜色也会发生改变，由远即近分别为：蓝色→绿色→黄色→红色。
Description.LocalizedString: Approaching Anomaly Awaiting Containment: Minimap radar activates when nearby. Radar color changes as distance decreases: Blue → Green → Yellow → Red.

Description.SourceString:
激活ReroRero电话亭或维特海默塔后，打开地图界面即可选择任意已激活的位置进行快速旅行。
若鉴定师拥有个人房产，则可在首次前往房产后作为快速旅行的目的地。
Description.LocalizedString:
After activating a ReroRero Phone Booth or Wertheimer Tower, check the Map to fast travel to any activated spot.
If you own personal property, visit it once to unlock it as a fast travel destination.

Description.SourceString: 除进行快速移动外，激活维特海默塔后，可获得其储存的周边区域信息，显示导航地图中对应的地图数据。
Description.LocalizedString: Activate a Wertheimer Tower to enable fast travel and retrieve stored information, revealing map data for the surrounding area.

Description.SourceString: 鉴定师所调查过的区域将标记在地图中，地图右下角可以查看<red>异象委托</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Investigated areas appear on the map. <red>Anomaly Commissions</> are shown in the bottom-right corner.

Description.SourceString: <red>赌徒「21」</>将赢来的筹码丢在城市各处，毕竟对于数字生命来说它并不需要这些。<red>不过有时候想要得到奖励，需要先解决一些麻烦……</>
Description.LocalizedString: <red>The gambler "21"</> has scattered winning chips throughout the city, since as a digital life form, it doesn't need them. <red>However, sometimes getting the reward requires dealing with some trouble first…</>

Description.SourceString: 热衷于在现身场所投映<red>「事故影片」</>的「时空放映机」，在其<red>「进度条」</>不稳定的<red>「波段」</>中，暗藏某些虚实难辨的<red>「蛛丝马迹」</>。参与者可在影片的任意进度中进行探寻，一旦追寻这些蛛丝马迹定位到影片中的「奇点」——多为<red>事故源头</>，「时空放映机」便会自然泯除。
Description.LocalizedString: The Spacetime Projector is keen on projecting <red>accident footage</> at the locations they appear in. Some <red>segments</> of the <red>progress bar</> of its videos can be unstable, and certain indistinguishable <red>clues</> are hidden there. Participants can explore different points in the video. Once they follow the clues and track down the Nexus of the video—often the <red>origin of the accidents</>—the Spacetime Projector will naturally become nullified.

Description.SourceString: 复制、增长，「增殖的C」从未，也绝对不会停止它的<red>增殖</>。当任何人试图接近它，无数的纸箱就会出现将其保护起来——尽管这些纸箱看起来不堪一击，但却比钢铁更加坚硬，即使有人踩在上面也不会有任何变化。当异象猎人在纸箱的<red>迷宫</>中找到<red>正确的通路</>，最终来到「增殖的C」面前，只需<red>封上纸箱</>那未封的口，对扩张和增殖的执念便会一同消散。
Description.LocalizedString: Replication and growth, the Proliferative C has never and will never stop <red>proliferating</>. When anyone tries to approach it, countless cardboard boxes will appear to protect it. Although these boxes seem fragile, they are harder than steel and will not break even if someone steps on them. When the Anomaly Hunter finds the <red>correct path</> in the <red>labyrinth</> of boxes and finally stands before the Proliferative C, simply <red>sealing the unsealed part of the box</> will cause its obsession with expansion and proliferation to dissipate.

Description.SourceString: 名为<red>「团三郎」</>的歧骸，为了获得心爱之物，会化作各种形态潜藏在城市中。但团三郎最喜欢的还是它的<red>「红餐巾」</>，无论变成什么样子，团三郎永远带着红餐巾，也许这是一个识破它的好方法。
Description.LocalizedString: The oddity <red>Danzaburou</> will transform into anything to try and steal what it wants! But, Danzaburou's favorite remains its <red>red scarf</>. No matter the form, Danzaburou always wears a red scarf, which could be a good way to identify it.

Description.SourceString: 名为<red>「团三郎」</>的歧骸，为了获得心爱之物，会化作各种形态潜藏在城市中。但团三郎最喜欢的还是它的<red>「红餐巾」</>，无论变成什么样子，团三郎永远带着红餐巾，也许这是一个识破它的好方法。
Description.LocalizedString: The oddity <red>Danzaburou</> will transform into anything to try and steal what it wants! But, Danzaburou's favorite remains its <red>red scarf</>. No matter the form, Danzaburou always wears a red scarf, which could be a good way to identify it.

Description.SourceString: 团三郎精通逃跑之术，快被追上时会用分身术四散逃离迷惑对手，<red>多次辨别出它的真身，识破团三郎的诡计吧。</>
Description.LocalizedString: Danzaburou is skilled in escape techniques, using decoys to scatter and confuse opponents when nearly caught. <red>Identify its true form multiple times to see through Danzaburou's tricks.</>

Description.SourceString: 欢迎来到<red>「魔女之家」</>，在这里可以将收集到的<red>「谕石」</>交给魔女小姐。若是陷入了迷茫，魔女小姐也会为你占卜运势，看清前路。
Description.LocalizedString: Welcome to <red>The Witch's House</>, where you can hand in <red>Oracle Stones</> to the witch. If you find yourself lost, the witch will also divine your luck and show you the road ahead.

Description.SourceString:
不知前路、难以落地的盲目乌鸦衔着的宝石，无人知晓它们来自何方。
有传言说捡到「谕石」的人会被厄运缠身，倘若不小心捡到也不用在意，<red>位于各地「魔女之家」中的魔女小姐似乎正在收集这些「谕石」。</>如果将「谕石」交给她的话，她不仅能为你消弭这份厄运，还会有对应的酬劳作为答谢。
Description.LocalizedString:
Gems carried by blind ravens, lost and unable to land, their origins unknown to all.
Rumors say that those who pick up Oracle Stones will be struck by misfortune, but don't worry if you happen to find one—<red>The mysterious lady from the Witch's House is collecting these Oracle Stones.</> If you hand her your Oracle Stones, not only will they dispel your misfortune, but also provide rewards.

Description.SourceString: 鉴定师在城市中临时<red>征用车辆</>时，薄荷将提供协助，帮助快速展开任务。然而，并非所有驾驶员都会配合征用请求。若选择<red>强行征用</>，将被视为违规行为，不仅会提升<red>「通缉值」</>，还可能遭到治安部队的<red>通缉</>。
Description.LocalizedString: When the Appraiser temporarily <red>requisitions vehicles</> in the city, Mint will provide assistance. However, not all drivers will comply with requisition requests. If you choose to <red>requisition by force</>, it will be considered a violation that not only increases your <red>warrant</> but may also result in being <red>wanted</> by security forces.

Description.SourceString: 购买车辆后，请在路边使用对应的<red>车钥匙</>，车辆即会停靠过来！
Description.LocalizedString: After buying a vehicle, use the <red>Key Fob</> by the roadside to summon it.

Description.SourceString: 在驾驶车辆时，您可以切换运动模式和舒适模式。舒适模式将会限制车辆最高速度，更适合在城市复杂的路况中行驶。
Description.LocalizedString: When driving, you can toggle between Sport Mode and Comfort Mode. Comfort Mode limits the vehicle's maximum speed, making it easier to drive in city traffic.

Description.SourceString: 道路千万条，安全第一条！如果车辆不慎受损，<red>「暴走玩家」</>会为您提供维修服务！此外，店里还可以改装车辆的外观和性能部件。
Description.LocalizedString: Safety first! If your vehicle gets damaged, <red>Rampage Players</> offers repair services! The shop also provides appearance and performance mods for your vehicle.

Description.SourceString: 在商铺内与吧台互动，可以打开商铺的管理界面，并对当前商铺进行管理操作。
Description.LocalizedString: Interact with the bar counter to bring up the interface and manage your shop.

Description.SourceString: 在商铺管理界面中，你可以调整雇员配置和出售的商品。
Description.LocalizedString: You can manage your employees and items here.

Description.SourceString: 在菜谱界面，你可以提升商品等级，也可以研发新的商品种类。
Description.LocalizedString: The recipe interface allows you to upgrade items and create new products.

Description.SourceString: 每种商品的出售都需要消耗对应的原料。确保在原料库存中存入足够的原料，才能顺利进行商品销售。
Description.LocalizedString: Ensure you have enough inventory to keep all items in stock.

Description.SourceString: 鉴定师可以在房屋中布置家装布局、邀请角色来访，曾经收容的异象也会在房屋中发挥能力。
Description.LocalizedString: As an Appraiser, you can customize your home's interior layout, invite characters to visit, and previously contained Anomalies will also put their abilities to use around the house.

Description.SourceString: 拖动家具图标将家具放在可放置区域内，点击确定后放置成功。
Description.LocalizedString: Drag furniture icons to their designated spots, then press Confirm to place them.

Description.SourceString: 与<red>「智能管家」</>对话，可购买和更换当前房屋的装修风格。
Description.LocalizedString: Talk to the <red>Butler</> to purchase and change the current house's decor style.

Description.SourceString: 探索各类<red>异象</>，收集并将<red>异象家具</>安置于房屋中。每件异象家具都拥有独特能力，带来不同效果。
Description.LocalizedString: Explore various <red>Anomalies</> to collect and place <red>Anomaly Furniture</> in your house. Each piece of Anomaly Furniture possesses unique abilities that provide different effects.

Description.SourceString: 解锁角色后，鉴定师可以将他们邀请至房屋中。角色会在房屋内进行各自的日常行为。
Description.LocalizedString: You can invite a character to your home after unlocking them. They will go about their daily routines there.

Description.SourceString: 与<red>「智能管家」</>对话，可收录当前房屋的风格摆设。
Description.LocalizedString: Talk to the <red>Butler</> to collect the current house's style and layout.

Description.SourceString: 收藏：收录家具可以提升收藏等级，获得<red>收藏奖励</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Collection: Collecting furniture increases your Collection Level and earns <red>Collection Rewards</>.

Description.SourceString: 城市的各个角落都有不同主题的扭蛋机，点击相应的扭蛋机并消费货币即可获得心仪的手办。这些手办既可以用作礼物赠送，也可以摆放在家中！
Description.LocalizedString: Gacha machines with different themes pop up all around the city. Hit the machine, spend your currency, and snag your desired figures. Collect 'em to show off at home or give as gifts to friends!

Description.SourceString: 首次获得的扭蛋将自动消耗并收藏，可以在房产中的手办柜查看。
Description.LocalizedString: The first gacha pull is automatically used and added to your collection. Check them out anytime in the Figure Cabinet at your property.

Description.SourceString: 消耗货币获得扭蛋并激活后，可将扭蛋摆件放入「手办柜」中，打造专属于你的理想痛柜！
Description.LocalizedString: Use currency to get and activate gachas, then place them in your Figure Cabinet to create your ideal display!

Description.SourceString:
这里是纳库佩达之池。纳库佩达爱好者协会的守护之地。
<red>向纳库佩达奉上它最喜欢吃的崭新闪亮亮硬币后，虔诚向其许愿，便可获得纳库佩达的祝福。</>每当有人许愿，纳库佩达就会现身。在纳库佩达爱好者看来，即使只是见到纳库佩达也能获得好运，不过这个说法并未得到确证。
只当图个好彩头，向许愿池掷下硬币吧。说不准会有好事发生？
慢着，这池子里满满当当全是硬币欸！
就算少了那么一两个，甚至一两堆，也看不出来吧……？
这股不寒而栗感是怎么回事？若是捞走纳库佩达的口粮，说不定会有可怕的事情发生……
Description.LocalizedString:
This is Nacupeda's Pool, the sacred grounds of the Nacupeda Fans Club.
<red>After offering shiny new coins—Nacupeda's favorite food—to it, pray sincerely to receive Nacupeda's blessing.</> Whenever someone makes a wish, Nacupeda appears. According to enthusiasts, simply seeing Nacupeda brings good fortune, though this claim remains unverified.
Just for good luck, toss a coin into the wishing pool. Who knows? Something good might happen!
Wait—this pool is absolutely filled with coins!
If one or two, or even a handful went missing, surely no one would notice…?
What's this chill running down my spine? If I take Nacupeda's food supply, something terrible might happen…

Description.SourceString: 投币启动抓娃娃机，调整视角、精准出手，赢取你的专属娃娃吧！
Description.LocalizedString: Insert coins to start the Claw Machine, adjust your view, aim precisely, and win your very own plushie!

Description.SourceString: 交互店内商品后将会引起店员的关注，玩家需要在店员注意力不集中时<red>选择对应行为</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Touching items in the shop can alert the staff. Wait for the right moment <red>before making your move</>.

Description.SourceString: 若玩家<red>选择的行为</>最终未引起店员的询问，则可强行获取商品。
Description.LocalizedString: If they <red>don't notice</>, you can grab the item safely.

Description.SourceString: 在强行获取商品后，会进入<red>隐匿状态</>，玩家需快速离开。若在隐匿状态中被店员发现，将会<red>强制支付</>方斯。
Description.LocalizedString: Taking it will put you in <red>Stealth mode</>. Don't linger! If a staff catches you while in stealth, you'll be <red>forced to pay</> Fons.

Description.SourceString: 遍布海特洛的<red>「一格」储物柜</>，其格口使用钥匙开启。有时，街道上会出现遗落的储物柜钥匙，拥有此钥匙，就可以前往对应的储物柜，使用相应的格口。
Description.LocalizedString: <red>"Griddy" storage lockers</> are scattered throughout Hethereau, with compartments that open using keys. Sometimes, lost storage locker keys can be found on the streets. With these keys, you can locate the corresponding locker and access the appropriate compartment.

Description.SourceString: 在城市的各处，总能捡到一些钥匙、钱包等他人的<red>遗失物品</>。这些物品都可以上交至任意治安所的<red>失物招领处</>，上交后，治安所会为这一拾金不昧的行为发放奖励予以表扬。
Description.LocalizedString: Throughout the city, you can find various <red>lost items</> like keys and wallets. These items can be turned in to the <red>Lost and Found</> at any Security Office. After turning them in, the Security Office will reward this honest act with prizes and praise.

Description.SourceString:
在城市中进行任何的违规行为都会积累<red>「通缉值」</>，当<red>「通缉值」</>积累到一定程度就会触发通缉。
在通缉状态下，鉴定师的部分行为将受到限制。
Description.LocalizedString:
Any illegal action in the city accumulates <red>Warrant Value</>. When your <red>Warrant Value</> reaches a certain threshold, you become Wanted.
While in the Wanted state, some of Appraiser's actions will be restricted.

Description.SourceString:
在城市中做出以下违规行为将累积<red>「通缉值」</>：
·<red>攻击</>城市中的行人或车辆
·<red>攻击</>治安人员或相关异象
·<red>强行征用</>他人车辆
·驾车<red>破坏</>公共设施
·其他对城市治安造成影响的行为
Description.LocalizedString:
The following actions in the city will increase your <red>Warrant Value</>:
<red>Attacking</> pedestrians or vehicles in the city.
<red>Attacking</> law enforcement officers or related Anomalies.
<red>Forcibly taking</> other people's vehicles.
<red>Damaging</> public property while driving.
Other actions that threaten city safety.

Description.SourceString:
如不慎累积通缉值，可通过以下方式降低通缉值：
·与追捕的治安官拉开<red>较远距离</>
·<red>返回房产</>，进入可降低通缉值的异象家具的作用范围
·食用<red>「善良脆鼠饼」</>
Description.LocalizedString:
Here are a few ways to bring your Warrant Value down if it gets too high.
1. Lose the pursuing Security Officers by putting <red>some distance</> between you and them.
2. Head back to your <red>Properties</> and step into the effect area of Anomaly Furniture that lowers Warrant Value.
3. Use <red>Goodheart Crispy Mouse Cookies</>.

Description.SourceString: <red>「善良脆鼠饼」</>是能够转移巡哨鼠鼠注意力的可口饼干。在通缉状态下使用，可以大幅<red>降低通缉值</>。
Description.LocalizedString: The tasty <red>Goodheart Crispy Mouse Cookie</> is great at pulling Officer Whisker's attention away. Use it while wanted to significantly <red>lower your Warrant Value</>.

Description.SourceString: 一旦被治安官逮捕，鉴定师将被转移至治安拘留所接受羁押。待羁押期满或缴清罚款后，即可获释离开拘留所。
Description.LocalizedString: Getting caught by a Security Officer sends you to the Hethereau Detention Center. You can leave after serving the detention time or paying the fine.

Description.SourceString: 在<red>店长模式</>中，鉴定师将亲自为客人制作食物，面对各种各样的需求与挑战。亲自动手可是一件既费心又费力的事，因此最好在精力充沛时再开门营业。同时也别忘了，客人的耐心可不是无限的——等待时间一到，可就要转身离开了。
Description.LocalizedString: In <red>Owner's Selection mode</>, you will personally prepare food for customers, facing various demands and challenges. Working hands-on is both mentally and physically taxing, so it's best to open for business when you're well-rested. Don't forget that customer patience isn't unlimited either—once their waiting time is up, they'll turn around and leave.

Description.SourceString: 食品制作台分为三种<red>不同类型</>的制作区域。面对蜂拥而至的客人，店长需要同时操作多个区域，灵活应对不同的点单需求，才能让大家满意而归。
Description.LocalizedString: The kitchen is divided into three <red>different types</> of cooking areas. Facing the flood of incoming customers, you will need to operate in multiple areas and respond to different order requirements to ensure everyone leaves satisfied.

Description.SourceString: 成功为客人提供食物后，店铺的营业额将随之提升。若能<red>连续成功</>，还可获得额外的<red>营业额加成</>。达到指定营业额后，店长便可解锁人流更密集、难度更高的营业阶段。
Description.LocalizedString: After successfully providing food to customers, the shop's revenue will increase accordingly. If you can achieve <red>consecutive successes</>, you can also earn additional <red>revenue bonuses</>. Once you reach the specified revenue target, you can unlock busier, more challenging stages.

Description.SourceString:
沦为废案后不愿屈服的<red>建筑设计图纸</>，会将人拉入纸上的异象空间，其中存在着它精心设计的奇特建筑。
参与者可通过探索建筑，收集<red>「散落的图纸」</>。其中包含具有特殊能力的<red>「投影图纸」</>和<red>「变维图纸」</>。使用<red>「投影图纸」</>，可以将自己和空间中的物体投影至平面；使用<red>「变维图纸」</>，可以变换投影的方向。活用图纸的能力，便可以借助物体投影作为平台进行移动、跳跃，从而抵达建筑的各个位置。
当参与者<red>集齐所有散落的图纸</>，即可完成挑战，离开异象空间。
Description.LocalizedString:
<red>Architectural blueprints</> that refuse to submit after being discarded will pull people into the Anomalous Realm on the paper, where the intricate buildings they designed exist.
Participants can explore the buildings to collect <red>Scattered Blueprints</>. These include <red>Projection Blueprints</> and <red>Dimension-Shift Blueprints</> with special abilities. Using <red>Projection Blueprints</>, you can project yourself and objects in the space onto a flat plane. Using <red>Dimension-Shift Blueprints</>, you can adjust the direction of the projection. By skillfully utilizing these blueprint abilities, you can use object projections as platforms to move and jump, reaching various locations throughout the buildings.
When participants <red>collect all the scattered blueprints</>, they can complete the challenge and exit the Anomalous Realm.

Description.SourceString: 使用<red>「投影图纸」</>后，异象空间内的物体会被投射、叠加至同一平面，可以在平面中借助各种物体的投影作为平台进行移动、跳跃，从而抵达在三维空间中难以触及的位置。
Description.LocalizedString: After using a <red>Projection Blueprint</>, objects within the Anomalous Realm will be projected and overlaid onto the same plane. You can use the projections of various objects as platforms to move and jump within the plane, allowing you to reach positions that would be difficult to access in three-dimensional space.

Description.SourceString: 使用<red>「变维图纸」</>后，可以在平面的视角下，围绕自己旋转投射平面的方向。观察不同平面视角下的物体投影，利用它们作为平台进行移动、跳跃，从而抵达在三维空间中难以触及的位置。
Description.LocalizedString: After using a <red>Dimension-Shift Blueprint</>, you can rotate the direction of the projection plane around yourself while in planar view. Observe the object projections from different planar perspectives and use them as platforms to move and jump, allowing you to reach positions that would be difficult to access in three-dimensional space.

Description.SourceString: 怪盗避役随手丢在街头的包裹，仍利用隐身绝技默默守护着其中的珍宝。要想得到宝物，必须避开它的视线——或许从「背后」靠近是个不错的手段。
Description.LocalizedString: The packages carelessly left on the streets by Chameleon the Thief are still guarded by an invisibility trick, silently protecting the treasures within. To claim the loot, you must stay out of its line of sight. Perhaps approaching from behind is a good idea.

Description.SourceString:
如在海特洛市治安拘留所接受羁押，须在<red>羁押期满</>或<red>缴清罚款</>后方可获释。
羁押期间，在押人员须遵守所内作息规定，按时间段安排活动。不同时段的活动范围将受到相应限制。可通过与监室<red>床铺</>或<red>活动区域出口</>处交互，进入下一时段。
如需提前结束羁押，可通过导航地图<red>快速移动</>或与<red>管教</>对话，足额缴纳罚款。
Description.LocalizedString:
If you're detained at Hethereau Detention Center, you'll be released only after your<red> detention period ends</> or <red>all fines are paid</>.
During detention, follow the daily schedule and take part in activities based on the current time block. Different areas are only accessible during certain periods. To move to the next block, interact with your <red>bed in the cell</> or <red>the exit of the activity area</>.
Want out early? <red>Fast travel</> via the map or speak with the<red>Warden</> and pay the full fine.

Description.SourceString:
在羁押期间，可以通过询问管教，了解拘留所作息规定或申请参与<red>所内劳动</>。
请注意：如在羁押期间有<red>违规行为</>，羁押期限将会相应<red>延长</>。
Description.LocalizedString:
You can ask the Warden about the daily schedule or sign up for <red>in-house labor</>.
Warning: Any <red>rule-breaking</> will <red>extend</> your detention.

Description.SourceString: 所内劳动是拘留所日常管理的一部分。羁押期间每日可参与两次劳动，在规定时间内使用高压水枪清洗岗楼污渍，完成后可获得少量方斯报酬。
Description.LocalizedString: Chores are part of the center's daily routine. Detainees may participate in chores twice per day, using high-pressure water cannons to clean stains from watchtowers within the assigned time period. Upon completion, detainees may receive a small amount of Fons.

Description.SourceString:
<red>工作总进度</>：清理污渍可提升进度，达100%即完成任务。
<red>污渍清洗进度</>：单处污渍清理至100%即清除，每处奖励1方斯。
<red>工作倒计时</>：需在限时内完成，结束后按作息进入午餐或宵禁阶段。
Description.LocalizedString:
<red>Total Progress</>: Removing stains can increase your progress. Reach 100% to finish the task.
<red>Stain Removal Progress</>: Remove a stain by reaching 100%. The reward of removing a stain is 10k Fons. 
<red>Work Countdown</>: Finish within the time limit. Once the activity ends, proceed to lunch time or curfew.

Description.SourceString:
<red>白色喷嘴</>：水流覆盖范围较广，但清洗速度与强度较低，只能清除普通污渍。
<red>红色喷嘴</>：水流覆盖范围较窄，但清洗速度与强度较高，适合处理顽固污渍。
<red>皂液喷嘴</>：配有储存罐，可将皂液喷洒于污渍表面以降低清洗难度。配合皂液使用时，任何强度的水流均可快速清除污渍。
Description.LocalizedString:
<red>White Nozzle</>: The water stream covers a wide area, but its cleaning speed is low, and it can only remove ordinary stains.
<red>Red Nozzle</>: The water stream has a narrower coverage area, but higher cleaning speed, making it suitable for removing stubborn stains.
<red>Detergent Nozzle</>: Comes with a storage tank that can spray detergent on stains for more efficient cleaning. When used with detergent, water streams of any intensity can remove stains quickly.

Description.SourceString: 在<red>时间限制</>内尽可能多地收集地图中的<red>「藏品」</>，<red>成功撤离</>后，本局收益将转化为等价方斯。当本期收益进度已达上限时，无法继续获得奖励。
Description.LocalizedString: Collect as many <red>Collectibles</> as possible on the map before <red>time runs out</>. <red>Evacuate</> to convert your earnings into Fons. Rewards will no longer accumulate once the cap is reached.

Description.SourceString: 地图中存在若干<red>「ReroRero电话亭」</>，在限时时间内选择一处随机激活的电话亭安全撤离。<red>超时或全部角色无法战斗后将失去全部收益</>。
Description.LocalizedString: <red>ReroRero Phone Booths</> appear on the map. Evacuate through any booth before time runs out. <red>If all characters are down or time expires, all earnings are lost</>.

Description.SourceString: 角色<red>受到伤害</>时，有<red>概率</>会损失收益，请谨慎<red>规划探索路线</>并注意角色当前状态。
Description.LocalizedString: <red>Taking damage</> <red>may</> cause you to lose earnings. <red>Plan your route</> and watch your characters' status.

Description.SourceString: 地图中除了存在有价值的藏品外，还散落着<red>「权限卡」</>、<red>「金库门禁卡」</>等功能性道具。此类道具本身不存在收益，但可开启存放大量藏品的房间；如本次行动未使用或撤离失败时，都将<red>永久保留在背包内</>，可将其带出玩法下次使用。
Description.LocalizedString: The map contains valuable Collectibles as well as functional items like <red>Clearance Cards</> and <red>Vault Access Cards</>. They don't grant earnings directly but can unlock rooms rich in Collectibles or be <red>carried</> into future runs if unused or if evacuation fails.

Description.SourceString:
在车辆赛事玩法中，因碰撞产生的车辆耐久度损耗会<red>大幅降低</>，具体为：
<red>「车队挑战」</>中，耐久度损耗降低<red>95%</>
<red>「在线对战」</>中，耐久度损耗降低<red>100%</>
<red>「好友挑战」</>中，耐久度损耗降低<red>95%</>
Description.LocalizedString:
In Races mode, collision damage to your vehicle is <red>heavily reduced</>:
<red>Challenge</>: <red>95%</> less durability loss
<red>Online Battle</>: <red>100%</> less durability loss
<red>Friends Challenge</>: <red>95%</> less durability loss

Description.SourceString:
在雨雪天气中，轮胎的抓地力会降低，导致车辆变得不易操控。
可在「车库」界面中为车辆更换对应的「雨胎」或「雪胎」，以恢复其操控性。
Description.LocalizedString:
Rain and snow reduce tire grip, making vehicles harder to control.
Restore handling by equipping rain or snow tires in the Garage.

Description.SourceString: 鉴定师每天都能在城市里偶遇相识的角色，不妨与他们相伴，共度一段美好时光。通过调整海特洛时间，每一天都有机会遇见不一样的伙伴。
Description.LocalizedString: Each day, the Appraiser may meet familiar characters around the city. Adjust Hethereau's time to encounter different companions.

Description.SourceString: 在敌人攻击命中前使用<red>闪避</>，即可成功闪避敌人的攻击，闪避将消耗体力，当体力不足时则无法使用闪避技能，体力会随时间回复。成功闪避后将触发<red>「极限闪避」</>并获得短暂的无敌效果。
Description.LocalizedString: Use <red>Dodge</> before an enemy attack lands to successfully evade it. Dodging consumes Stamina. When Stamina is insufficient, you cannot Dodge. Stamina recovers over time. A successful Dodge triggers <red>Critical Dodge</> and grants brief invincibility.

Description.SourceString: 触发<red>「极限闪避」</>后一段时间内进行<red>「普通攻击」</>可以触发<red>「极限反击」</>，<red>「极限反击」</>可以大幅扣除敌人的倾陷值。
Description.LocalizedString: A <red>Critical Riposte</> can be performed by using <red>Basic Attacks</> shortly after triggering <red>Critical Dodge</>. <red>Critical Riposte</> can effectively Break an enemy.

Description.SourceString: 通常情况下，当敌人受到攻击时会扣除<red>「倾陷值」</>，敌人的<red>「倾陷值」</>会显示在生命值的下方；当<red>「倾陷值」</>完全扣除时敌人会进入<red>「倾陷状态」</>，陷入瘫痪无法行动并受到一次<red>「倾陷伤害」</>，伤害量与队伍中所有角色相关。<red>「倾陷状态」</>会在一段时间后解除。
Description.LocalizedString: Enemies lose <red>Break</> when damaged. Their <red>Break</> shows under HP. When <red>Break</> reaches zero, they become <red>Broken</>, cannot act, and take <red>Break Damage</> based on your team. They recover from <red>Broken</> after a short period.

Description.SourceString: 部分敌人的<red>「倾陷状态」</>会有特殊效果。
Description.LocalizedString: Some enemies may experience special effects when <red>Broken</>.

Description.SourceString: 对敌人造成伤害时将积累<red>终结能量</>。当终结能量达到最大值，即可释放威力强大的<red>极轨终结</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Dealing damage to enemies accumulate <red>Ultimate Energy</>. Cast a powerful <red>Ultimate</> when the Ultimate Energy reaches maximum capacity.

Description.SourceString: 当敌人施放特殊招式时，将出现<red>预警提示</>。此时若使用普通攻击、变轨技能、援护技和极限闪避反击等特定攻击命中敌人，即可触发<red>承轨反击</>，成功格挡本次攻击并令目标进入硬直状态。完成格挡后，角色将获得一定的<red>环合值</>，同时自动衔接<red>极限闪避</>。
Description.LocalizedString: When an enemy prepares a special move, a <red>Warning Indicator</> appears. Hit the enemy at this moment with a Basic Attack, Redirect Skill, Support Skill, or Critical Dodge Counter to trigger a <red>Parry Attack</>, blocking the incoming strike and stunning the target. After a successful parry, your character gains <red>Cycle Rate</> and automatically chains into a <red>Critical Dodge</>.

Description.SourceString: 部分敌人具有自身<red>弱点</>，该弱点会以图标显示于其头顶。对弱点属性使用异能攻击时，可以造成更高的伤害。
Description.LocalizedString: Target enemies with <red>weaknesses</> shown as icons above their heads. Use Esper Ability attacks matching their weakness type to deal increased damage.

Description.SourceString: 同时，若使用对应属性的<red>援护技能</>，还可额外扣除<red>倾陷值</>，加速敌人的破绽生成。
Description.LocalizedString: Additionally, casting attribute-matching <red>Support Skills</> further reduces the enemy’s <red>Break</>, helping expose them faster.

Description.SourceString: 一般情况下，角色在战斗中造成伤害时会累积当前角色的<red>「环合值」</>；<red>「环合值」</>充满时，队伍中能与该角色发生<red>「异能环合」</>的角色头像会有特殊显示。
Description.LocalizedString: In most circumstances, characters will accumulate <red>Cycle Gauge</> during combat. When <red>Cycle Gauge</> is full, team members who can form an <red>Esper Cycle</> with the current character will display an indicator on their avatars.

Description.SourceString: 当前场上角色<red>「环合值」</>充满时，切换能够与之发生<red>「异能环合」</>的角色，入场角色会释放<red>「入轨攻击」</>并清空上一位角色的<red>「环合值」</>；如果入场角色使用的<red>「入轨攻击」</>命中了敌人则会触发对应<red>「异能环合」</>效果。
Description.LocalizedString: When the current character's <red>Cycle Gauge</> is full, switching to another character who can form an <red>Esper Cycle</> with them allows the new character to perform an <red>Entry Attack</> and reset the <red>Cycle Gauge</> of the previous character. <red>Entry Attack</> applies corresponding <red>Esper Cycle</> effects to damaged enemies.

Description.SourceString: 当光属性异能和灵属性异能进行<red>「异能环合」</>时会引发<red>「创生」</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Cosmos and Anima Espers trigger <red>Esper Cycle</>, inflicting <red>Blossom</>.

Description.SourceString: 角色附近将出现数株<red>「创生株」</>，每隔一段时间数朵<red>「创生花」</>会陆续飞向射程内的目标并爆炸，造成一定范围伤害。
Description.LocalizedString: <red>Vita Bud</> will spawn near the character. Periodically, some <red>Vita Pistils</> will fly toward targets and explode, dealing damage to an area.

Description.SourceString: 当灵属性异能和咒属性异能进行<red>「异能环合」</>的时候会引发<red>「覆纹」</>，其后的一段时间内，目标受到灵属性或咒属性异能伤害时，将额外受到一次原伤害<red>20%</>的<red>「追加攻击」</>伤害。
Description.LocalizedString: Anima and Incantation Esper Abilities trigger <red>Esper Cycle</>, inflicting <red>Hexed</>. For its duration, the target takes an additional instance of <red>follow-up</> damage equal to half the Anima or Incantation damage taken.

Description.SourceString: 当光属性异能和相属性异能进行<red>「异能环合」</>的时候会引发<red>「延滞」</>，其后的一段时间内，目标进入延滞状态，移动及攻击速度降低，并随时间逐渐复原。如频繁进入延滞状态，目标恢复至常态的速度将会加快。
Description.LocalizedString: Cosmos and Lakshana Esper Abilities trigger <red>Esper Cycle</>, inflicting <red>Remora</>, slowing the target's movement and attack speed for its duration. Frequent Remora speeds up the target's recovery.

Description.SourceString: 当暗属性异能和魂属性异能进行<red>「异能环合」</>的时候会引发<red>「黯星」</>，其后的一段时间内，目标进入黯星状态。
Description.LocalizedString: Chaos and Psyche Esper Abilities trigger <red>Esper Cycle</>, inflicting <red>Nova</> on the target for its duration.

Description.SourceString: 黯星状态状态结束时，目标将受到一次高额<red>「心灵伤害」</>。
Description.LocalizedString: The target suffers significant <red>Mental DMG</> when Nova ends.

Description.SourceString: 当咒属性异能和暗属性异能进行<red>「异能环合」</>的时候会引发<red>「浊燃」</>，其后的一段时间内，目标进入浊燃状态，期间受到持续伤害。
Description.LocalizedString: Incantation and Chaos Esper Abilities trigger <red>Esper Cycle</>, inflicting <red>Scorch</>, dealing DoT for its duration.

Description.SourceString: 当魂属性异能和相属性异能进行<red>「异能环合」</>的时候会引发<red>「浸染」</>，其后的一段时间内，目标受到魂属性或相属性异能伤害时，所受伤害量提升。
Description.LocalizedString: Psyche and Lakshana Esper Abilities trigger <red>Esper Cycle</>, inflicting <red>Stain</>, increasing enemies' damage taken from these Esper Abilities for its duration.

Description.SourceString: 当队伍中同时拥有光灵相三个属性时可触发异能环合<red>「盈蓄」</>，<red>「盈蓄」</>为<red>「延滞」</>与<red>「创生」</>的结合。<red>「创生花」</>命中处于<red>延滞</>状态的目标的时候会引发<red>盈蓄</>，当前驻场角色额外获得<red>终结能量</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Having Cosmos, Anima, and Lakshana attributes in the team triggers Esper Cycle <red>Charge</>. <red>Charge</> combines <red>Remora</> and <red>Blossom</>. Hitting·<red>Remora-marked</>·targets·with·<red>Vita Pistils</>·triggers·<red>Charge</>,·granting·the active character<red>Ultimate·Energy</>.

Description.SourceString: 当队伍中同时拥有暗魂咒三个属性时可触发异能环合<red>「失谐」</>，<red>「失谐」</>为<red>「黯星」</>与<red>「浊燃」</>的结合，当目标同时处于<red>黯星</>与<red>浊燃</>状态的时候会引发<red>失谐</>，扣除其一定比例的<red>倾陷值</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Having Chaos, Psyche, and Incantation attributes in the team triggers Esper Cycle <red>Discord</>. <red>Discord</> combines <red>Nova</> and <red>Scorch</>. Triggers <red>Discord</> by affecting targets simultaneously with <red>Nova</> and <red>Scorch</>, reducing a percentage of their <red>Break</>.

Description.SourceString:
白藏是一位<red>输出型</>的<red>近战角色</>。攻击可以在敌方身上生成<red>言灵字</>。不同的言灵字在白藏的「极轨终结：判予秋」中会触发不同的效果：
触发「噤」字可造成<red>单体高伤害</>；
触发「詈」字可造成<red>群体伤害</>；
触发「祝」字可造成<red>单体伤害</>，并回复白藏一定比例的<red>最大生命值</>。

阿德勒是一位<red>生存型</>的<red>远程角色</>。
使用「变轨技能：诛恶护持」能够在造成<red>咒系伤害</>的同时为全队角色施加<red>护盾</>「明悟之慧佑」。
使用「普通攻击：度恶」和「普通攻击：灭苦」并命中敌人时，阿德勒会获得<red>「业」标记</>。当阿德勒持有「业」标记时使用「变轨技能：诛恶护持」会消耗所有的「业」标记并提高「变轨技能：诛恶护持」造成的伤害。
Description.LocalizedString:
Adler is a <red>Survival-type</> <red>ranged character</>.
Casting Redirect Skill: Evil's Bane deals <red>Incantation DMG</> and grants a <red>Shield</> Blessing to the Team.
Hitting enemies with Basic Attack: Deliverance or Basic Attack: Liberation generates <red>Karma Marks</>. When Adler casts Evil's Bane with Karma Marks, all marks are consumed to greatly increase its damage.

Description.SourceString:
翳是一名<red>输出型</>的<red>近战角色</>。使用「普通攻击：拘管格斗术」和「变轨技能：潜影追击」对敌人造成伤害时令敌人附着<red>「兽牙影刺」</>，附着有<red>「兽牙影刺」</>的敌人一段时间后会再次受到伤害。
翳使用「变轨技能：潜影追击」后进入<red>「啮逐潜影」</>状态，在该状态下，翳与附着有<red>「兽牙影刺」</>的敌人接触时会对其造成伤害。
Description.LocalizedString:
Skia is a <red>damage-focused</> <red>melee character</>. Using Basic Attack: Arresting Art and Redirect Skill: Shadow Hound Chase afflict enemies with <red>Fang Thrust</>. Enemies with <red>Fang Thrust</> will take damage again after a period of time.
After Skia uses Redirect Skill: Shadow Hound Chase, he enters the <red>Shadow Hound Gnaw</> state, dealing damage to enemies afflicted with <red>Fang Thrust</> by getting in contact with them.

Description.SourceString:
法帝娅是一位以<red>伤害分摊</>为核心的<red>生存角色</>。当法帝娅当前生命值<red>大于1点</>时，能利用异能替队友分摊护盾抵挡前的伤害。
使用「变轨技能：存在证明的体验」可以对范围内生命上限最高的敌方单位施加「破灭体验」，持续时间内，当法帝娅自身受到伤害时，目标将会<red>共享</>法帝娅所受伤害量的部分伤害。
法帝娅使用「极轨终结：痛苦让位于狂喜」后进入「敌神者」状态并<red>回复生命值</>。在「敌神者」状态下，再次释放「普通攻击：话语中断的否定」可进行至多五段追击，每次追击造成<red>心灵伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString:
Fadia is a <red>Survival character</> centered around <red>Damage Redirect</>. When Fadia's current HP is <red>greater than 1 point</>, she can use her Esper Ability to redirect damage for teammates before it hits their shields.
Using Redirect Skill: Existence applies Destructive Experience to the enemy with the highest Max HP within range. During this effect, when Fadia takes damage, the target will <red>share</> part of the damage Fadia receives.
After using Ultimate: Agony to Euphoria, Fadia enters Lilith state and <red>recovers HP</>. While in Lilith state, using Basic Attack: Wordless Rejection again allows up to five follow-up attacks, with each follow-up dealing <red>Mental DMG</>.

Description.SourceString:
浔是一位能够提供<red>输出增益</>，且具有一定爆发输出能力的<red>辅助型角色</>。当浔编入队伍之后会随时间为「非闭合时计」积蓄能量。
「非闭合时计」存在积蓄能量且处于<red>非战斗状态</>时，长按普通攻击可进入「凝雪之仪」状态，停止时间流动。
「非闭合时计」积蓄的能量不少于一半时，使用「变轨技能：今景复映」可<red>鉴赏并记录</>全队接下来一段时间内发动的<red>「援护技」</>和<red>「变轨技能」</>。
「非闭合时计」能量<red>蓄满</>时可使用「极轨终结：浮世来潮」，切换使用太刀攻击并停止周围的时间流动。时停期间，「非闭合时计」的指针将持续回拨。此外，浔的太刀攻击会积累段势，段势积累到10段时造成<red>终结伤害</>。指针回拨到低或造成终结伤害都会结束时停。
Description.LocalizedString:
Hotori is a <red>Support</> who provides <red>damage buffs</> while also having significant Burst DMG potential. When added to the team, the Non-Closed Timepiece begins to accumulate energy over time.
When the Timepiece has accumulated energy and Hotori is <red>out of combat</>, holding Basic Attack activates the Frozen Snow Ritual, slowing time to a near standstill.
Once the Timepiece has at least half of its energy, casting Present Replay <red>observes and records</> all <red>Support Skills</> and <red>Redirect Skills</> cast by the team for a set duration.
When the Timepiece is <red>fully charged</>, casting World's Tide switches Hotori to katana attacks and nearly halts time in the surrounding area. During this time stop, the Timepiece pointer continuously rewinds. Katana attacks build combo stacks, and reaching 10 stacks triggers <red>Ultimate DMG</>, which, or the pointer rewinding to its minimum, ends the time stop.

Description.SourceString:
娜娜莉是一位以<red>追加攻击</>为核心的<red>输出角色</>。
长按普通攻击可以使用「普通攻击：重拳出击！」
使用「极轨终结：柯林斯·终极术」后召唤「副手」，「副手」在场时娜娜莉的所有攻击均会命令副手进行<red>追加攻击</>。
使用「变轨技能：柯林斯·嗷呜术」之后进入「一代目的权柄」状态，该状态下娜娜莉的攻击对受到<red>异能环合</>伤害的目标会造成<red>追加攻击</>。
Description.LocalizedString:
Nanally is a <red>Damage Character</> centered around <red>follow-up attacks</>.
Hold Basic Attack to use Basic Attack: Heavy Hitter!
After using Ultimate: Colucci Ultimate Technique, she summons an Underboss. While the Underboss is active, all of Nanally's attacks will command the Underboss to perform <red>follow-up attacks</>.
After using Redirect Skill: Colucci Black Cat Technique, she enters Ichi-daime's Authority state. In this state, Nanally's attacks against targets that have taken <red>Esper Cycle</> damage will trigger <red>follow-up attacks</>.

Description.SourceString:
早雾是一位能提供<red>控制</>和<red>输出</>方面增益的<red>辅助型</>角色。长按普攻，早雾可坐到鬼郎丸上，期间可移动并持续吸引扇形范围内的目标，弱小的敌人会被吸至身前并<red>吞噬</>。
点按释放「变轨技能：打嗝」可<red>吸附敌人</>并将敌人撞倒，长按释放「变轨技能：噬重」可吸附敌人并咬穿地面重力，位于此处的敌人会<red>悬浮到空中</>。
「极轨终结：千钧隆重的饕餮宴」可<red>压制敌人</>。
Description.LocalizedString:
Sakiri is a <red>Support</> Character who provides <red>Control</> and <red>Damage</> buffs. Hold Basic Attack to have Sakiri mount Kiroumaru, during which she can move and continuously pull targets in a cone. Weak enemies will be pulled close and <red>devoured</>.
Press to cast Burp to <red>pull enemies</> in and knock them down. Hold to cast Gravity Eater to pull enemies in and bite through the ground's gravity, causing enemies in the area to <red>float into the air</>.
Feast of Gluttony can <red>Suppress enemies</>.

Description.SourceString:
薄荷是一位<red>输出型</>的<red>近战角色</>。
「变轨技能：奥义·超级连风爪」的冷却较短，与长按普通攻击交替使用可在较短的时间内完成输出。
Description.LocalizedString:
Mint is a <red>damage-focused</> <red>melee character</>.
Her Redirect Skill: Ultimate: Super Claws has a short cooldown. Alternating between this skill and holding Basic Attack allows for high damage output in a short time.

Description.SourceString: 埃德嘉是一位以<red>治疗</>为核心的<red>生存型角色</>，其变轨技能可持续治疗<red>生命值最低</>的队友，极轨终结可治疗<red>当前角色</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Edgar is a <red>healing-focused</> <red>Survival character</>. His Redirect Skill continuously heals the teammate with the <red>lowest HP</>, and his Ultimate can heal the <red>current character</>.

Description.SourceString:
小吱是一位<red>近程输出型角色</>。
长按普通攻击使用「普通攻击：荒谷」可<red>吞噬小型怪物</>并<red>获得方斯</>。
使用「普通攻击：失乡剑术」可获得<red>「金谷」</>，长按「变轨技能：粉爪在上原则」<red>消耗金谷</>，并根据金谷数量造成<red>高额伤害</>。
使用「极轨终结：零和博弈」进入<red>「金谷市场」</>，持续时间内，每次使用「变轨技能：粉爪在上原则」时根据当前<red>「金谷K线」</>的波动<red>结算金谷</>。
长按「变轨技能：粉爪在上原则」可依次释放「变轨技能：空仓」、「变轨技能：半仓」、「变轨技能：满仓」，释放期间即使<red>切换角色</>，小吱仍将<red>留在场上</>直到攻击结束。
Description.LocalizedString:
Chiz is a <red>damage-focused melee character</>.
Hold Basic Attack to use Basic Attack: Blighted Vale, which <red>devours small mobs</> and <red>grants Fons</>.
Use Basic Attack: Exiled Swordplay to gain <red>Grain</>. Hold Redirect Skill: Pink Paws Priority Principle to <red>consume Grain</> and deal <red>high damage</> based on the amount of Grain.
Use Ultimate: Zero-Sum Game to enter the <red>Grain Market</>. While the market is open, each use of Redirect Skill: Pink Paws Priority Principle will <red>settle the Grain</> based on the current <red>Grain Price</>, which fluctuates over time.
Hold Redirect Skill: Pink Paws Priority Principle to cast Redirect Skill: No Grain, Redirect Skill: Half Grain, and Redirect Skill: Full Grain, in that order. Even if you <red>switch characters</> while casting these skills, Chiz will <red>remain on the battlefield</> until the attack finishes.

Description.SourceString:
九原是一位中远程的<red>输出型角色</>。
释放<red>「变轨技能：情报猎手」</>后能够与周围目标缔结<red>「致命玫约」</>，释放<red>「极轨终结：终局清账」</>可以触发<red>「致约清算」</>，引爆<red>「致命玫约」</>。
使用<red>普通攻击</>，<red>极限反击</>和<red>变轨技能</>时可获取<red>「玫约子弹」</>。
当九原拥有<red>「玫约子弹」</>时可释放分支普通攻击，优先攻击带有<red>「致命玫约」</>的敌人并加速进入<red>「致约清算」</>。
Description.LocalizedString:
Jiuyuan is a mid-to-long-range <red>DMG</> character.
After casting <red>Intel Hunter</>, Jiuyuan forges a <red>Lethal Rose Pact</> with nearby targets. Casting <red>Final Reckoning</> triggers <red>Pact Settlement</>, detonating existed <red>Lethal Rose Pact</>.
Using <red>Basic Attack</>, <red>Critical Riposte</>, and <red>Redirect Skill</> generates <red>Rose Pact Bullets</>.
Owned <red>Rose Pact Bullets</> trigger branch Basic Attack that targets enemies marked with <red>Lethal Rose Pact</> and speeds up entry into <red>Pact Settlement</>.

Description.SourceString:
哈索尔是一位<red>近战输出型角色</>。
通过<red>「极限反击：零误差行动」</>，<red>「变轨技能：空中指令」</>，<red>「优评锁定」</>和<red>「满星追踪」</>可以获得<red>「闪送之力」</>。
释放<red>「极轨终结：铁骑速递」</>进入<red>「紧急派送」</>状态，可释放<red>「变轨技能：轮转打击」</>。
Description.LocalizedString:
Hathor is a <red>Melee-DMG</> character.
She gains <red>Express Delivery Power</> through <red>Zero-Error Operation</>, <red>Aerial Command</>, <red>Excellent Rating Lock</>, and <red>Five-Star Tracking</>.
Cast <red>Rider Express</> to enter the <red>Emergency Delivery</> state, allowing the use of <red>Cyclone Strike</>.

Description.SourceString:
达芙蒂尔是一位爆发型，能提供倾陷增益的<red>近战输出型</>角色。
在普通攻击过程中点按闪避可触发特殊闪避<red>「错位锋芒」</>，闪避期间无敌且<red>不打断</>当前的连段攻击。
全队角色释放<red>援护技</>时可提升<red>「变轨技能：同振」</>造成的伤害和倾陷值，最多提升两次。提升至上限后，<red>「变轨技能：同振」</>将强化替换为<red>「变轨技能：如响斯应」</>。
释放<red>极轨终结</>后新增技能<red>「幻影移形」</>，从其他角色切换至达芙蒂尔时自动释放。
<red>「极轨终结：见此终幕」</>会给目标添加<red>「洞察」</>，若目标在<red>「洞察」</>效果期间进入<red>倾陷状态</>将额外受到一次达芙蒂尔造成的<red>倾陷伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString:
Daffodill is a Burst-type, <red>Melee-DMG</> character who provides Break Boost.
Press Dodge during a Basic Attack to trigger the special Dodge <red>Displaced Edge</>. She is invincible while Dodging and <red>does not interrupt</> her current combo.
When an ally casts a <red>Support Skill</>, it increases the damage and Break dealt by <red>Resonance</>, up to 2 stacks. At maximum stacks, <red>Resonance</> is upgraded and replaced by <red>Echoes</>.
After using her <red>Ultimate</>, Daffodill unlocks a new skill, <red>Phantom Step</>, which automatically activates when switching to Daffodill from another character.
<red>Finale</> inflicts <red>Insight</> on the target. If the target enters a <red>Break state</> while affected by <red>Insight</>, they take an additional instance of <red>Break DMG</> from Daffodill.

Description.SourceString:
海月是一名远程的<red>输出型角色</>。
长按闪避可持续释放<red>「普通攻击：顿音」</>，发射<red>音弹</>对附近敌人造成伤害。
<red>「变轨技能：华彩唱段」</>可强化所有<red>「普通攻击：顿音」</>发射的<red>音弹</>。
Description.LocalizedString:
Aurelia is a <red>Ranged-DMG</> character.
Hold Dodge to continuously cast <red>Staccato</>, firing <red>sound blasts</> that deal damage to nearby enemies.
<red>Cadenza Aria</> enhances all <red>sound blasts</> fired by <red>Staccato</>.

Description.SourceString:
哈尼娅是一位中远程的<red>辅助型角色</>。
<red>「变轨技能：静默月林的守护者」</>将在前方区域释放<red>「咕咕子」</>，为<red>全队</>提供<red>增益效果</>。<red>「咕咕子」</>存在时，持续攻击命中敌人会触发<red>「合奏」</>，造成范围伤害，此效果当哈尼娅在后台时仍然生效。
<red>「极轨终结：名为『哈尼娅』的旋律」</>将为<red>全队</>提供<red>增益效果</>并<red>强化自身</>，提升<red>「合奏」</>效果，此效果当哈尼娅在后台时仍然生效。
解锁被动<red>「是羁绊啊」</>后，每次触发<red>「合奏」</>时哈尼娅可获取<red>「主角光环」</>。哈尼娅可通过蓄力攻击消耗所有<red>「主角光环」</>造成弹射。
Description.LocalizedString:
Haniel is a mid-to-long range <red>Support</>.
<red>Silent Moonlit Forest Guardian</> summons <red>Hootie</> in the area ahead, granting <red>buffs</> to the <red>entire team</>. While <red>Hootie</> is active, continuously hitting enemies triggers <red>Ensemble</>, dealing AoE DMG; this effect remains active even when Haniel is off the field.
<red>A Melody Named Haniel</> grants <red>buffs</> to the <red>entire team</> and <red>boosts Haniel</>, enhancing the <red>Ensemble</> effect; this effect also remains active when Haniel is off the field.
After unlocking the passive skill <red>It's Bond!</>, whenever <red>Ensemble</> is triggered, Haniel gains <red>Plot Armor</>. Haniel can consume all <red>Plot Armor</> stacks with a charged attack to fire ricocheting projectiles.

Description.SourceString:
安魂曲是一位以<red>持续伤害</>为核心的<red>输出角色</>。
可以在<red>近战攻击</>和<red>远程攻击</>两种模式下进行切换，应对各种复杂的战况。
攻击命中敌人时，可以叠加<red>「噩梦」</>，对敌人造成持续伤害。
安魂曲可以<red>记忆</>部分敌人的技能并释放。
此外，切换安魂曲触发异能环合<red>「失谐」</>时，若攻击目标已处于失衡状态，则对目标<red>额外</>造成高额伤害。
Description.LocalizedString:
Lacrimosa is a <red>DPS character</> focused on <red>damage over time</>.
She can switch between <red>melee attacks</> and <red>ranged attacks</> to handle various combat situations.
When her attacks hit enemies, she can stack <red>Nightmare</>, dealing damage over time.
Lacrimosa can <red>memorize</> certain enemy skills and use them herself.
In addition, when switching to Lacrimosa triggers the Esper Cycle <red>Discord</>, she deals heavy <red>bonus</> damage if the target is already Broken.

Description.SourceString:
卡厄斯是一位擅长<red>中近程</>战斗的<red>输出角色</>。
普通攻击和变轨技能命中敌人后能积攒<red>「罪状」</>。
长按<red>普通攻击</>可以释放强化普通攻击。
「罪状」达到上限后，释放<red>强化普通攻击</>并在结束后立刻衔接<red>普通攻击</>可以释放威力强大的第二段<red>强化普通攻击</>。
释放极轨终结会进入强化状态<red>「恶名往复」</>，期间「罪状」会随时间快速回复，强化期间内可以释放更多的<red>强化普通攻击</>。
Description.LocalizedString:
Chaos is a <red>DPS character</> who excels at <red>mid- to close-range</> combat.
His Basic Attacks and Redirect Skills build <red>Crime</> when they hit enemies.
Hold <red>Basic Attack</> to release an Enhanced Basic Attack.
When Crime reaches its cap, release an <red>Enhanced Basic Attack</>, then immediately chain into a <red>Basic Attack</> at the end to release a powerful second <red>Enhanced Basic Attack</>.
Casting his Ultimate puts Chaos into the enhanced state <red>Dread Echo</>. While this state is active, Crime rapidly recovers over time, allowing Chaos to release more <red>Enhanced Basic Attacks</>.

Description.SourceString: 当光属性异能和灵属性异能进行<red>「异能环合」</>时会引发<red>「创生」</>。角色附近将出现数株<red>「创生株」</>，每隔一段时间数朵<red>「创生花」</>会陆续飞向射程内的目标并爆炸，造成一定范围伤害。
Description.LocalizedString: Cosmos and Anima Espers trigger <red>Esper Cycle</>, inflicting <red>Blossom</>.Generates several <red>Vita Buds</> near the target after triggering Esper Cycle, which blossoms <red>Vita Pistils</>. Vita Pistils periodically fly toward targets within range, exploding and dealing AoE DMG.

Description.SourceString: 当灵属性异能和咒属性异能进行<red>「异能环合」</>的时候会引发<red>「覆纹」</>，其后的一段时间内，目标受到灵属性或咒属性异能伤害时，将额外受到一次原伤害<red>20%</>的<red>「追加攻击」</>伤害。
Description.LocalizedString: Anima and Incantation Esper Abilities trigger <red>Esper Cycle</>, inflicting <red>Hexed</>. For its duration, the target takes an additional instance of <red>follow-up</> damage equal to half the Anima or Incantation damage taken.

Description.SourceString: 当光属性异能和相属性异能进行<red>「异能环合」</>的时候会引发<red>「延滞」</>，其后的一段时间内，目标进入延滞状态，移动及攻击速度降低，并随时间逐渐复原。如频繁进入延滞状态，目标恢复至常态的速度将会加快。
Description.LocalizedString: Cosmos and Lakshana Esper Abilities trigger <red>Esper Cycle</>, inflicting <red>Remora</>, slowing the target's movement and attack speed for its duration. Frequent Remora speeds up the target's recovery.

Description.SourceString: 当暗属性异能和魂属性异能进行<red>「异能环合」</>的时候会引发<red>「黯星」</>，其后的一段时间内，目标进入黯星状态。
Description.LocalizedString: Chaos and Psyche Esper Abilities trigger <red>Esper Cycle</>, inflicting <red>Nova</> on the target for its duration.

Description.SourceString: 当咒属性异能和暗属性异能进行<red>「异能环合」</>的时候会引发<red>「浊燃」</>，其后的一段时间内，目标进入浊燃状态，期间受到持续伤害。
Description.LocalizedString: Incantation and Chaos Esper Abilities trigger <red>Esper Cycle</>, inflicting <red>Scorch</>, dealing DoT for its duration.

Description.SourceString: 当魂属性异能和相属性异能进行<red>「异能环合」</>的时候会引发<red>「浸染」</>，其后的一段时间内，目标受到魂属性或相属性异能伤害时，所受伤害量提升。
Description.LocalizedString: Psyche and Lakshana Esper Abilities trigger <red>Esper Cycle</>, inflicting <red>Stain</>, increasing enemies' damage taken from these Esper Abilities for its duration.

Description.SourceString: 当队伍中同时拥有光灵相三个属性时可触发异能环合<red>「盈蓄」</>，<red>「盈蓄」</>为<red>「延滞」</>与<red>「创生」</>的结合。<red>「创生花」</>命中处于<red>延滞</>状态的目标的时候会引发<red>盈蓄</>，当前驻场角色额外获得<red>终结能量</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Having Cosmos, Anima, and Lakshana attributes in the team triggers Esper Cycle <red>Charge</>. <red>Charge</> combines <red>Remora</> and <red>Blossom</>. Hitting·<red>Remora-marked</>·targets·with·<red>Vita Pistils</>·triggers·<red>Charge</>,·granting·the active character<red>Ultimate·Energy</>.

Description.SourceString: 当队伍中同时拥有暗魂咒三个属性时可触发异能环合<red>「失谐」</>，<red>「失谐」</>为<red>「黯星」</>与<red>「浊燃」</>的结合，当目标同时处于<red>黯星</>与<red>浊燃</>状态的时候会引发<red>失谐</>，扣除其一定比例的<red>倾陷值</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Having Chaos, Psyche, and Incantation attributes in the team triggers Esper Cycle <red>Discord</>. <red>Discord</> combines <red>Nova</> and <red>Scorch</>. Triggers <red>Discord</> by affecting targets simultaneously with <red>Nova</> and <red>Scorch</>, reducing a percentage of their <red>Break</>.

Description.SourceString: 猎人等级提升后，可领取对应等级的奖励。
Description.LocalizedString: You can claim rewards corresponding to your Hunter Level after it increases.

Description.SourceString: 鉴定师所调查过的区域将标记在地图中。地图右下角可以切换为<red>异视投影地图</>
Description.LocalizedString: Areas investigated by the Appraiser will be marked on the map. You can switch to the <red>Anomagram</> in the bottom-right corner of the map.

Description.SourceString: 通过<red>异视投影</>，鉴定师可以持续追踪已接受的<red>异象委托</>，并在调查中逐步拨开迷雾。
Description.LocalizedString: Through the <red>Anomagram</>, the Appraiser can track accepted <red>Anomaly Commissions</> and explore the map.

Description.SourceString: 使用闪避技能可以发动闪避，闪避将消耗体力，当体力不足时则无法使用闪避技能，体力会随时间回复。
Description.LocalizedString: Dodge incoming attacks. Dodging consumes Stamina, which recovers over time. Cannot Dodge when Stamina is low.

Description.SourceString: 与周围格格不入的昂贵皮箱，是「鼎鼎大名」的<red>「迦楼罗」的战利品。</>想要抢迦楼罗的东西？那就得看看有没有这个实力！
Description.LocalizedString: An expensive suitcase that stands out from its surroundings, this is a trophy belonging to the <red>infamous Garuda.</> Want to steal from Garuda? You'd better see if you have what it takes!

Description.SourceString: 想在海特洛市拥有属于自己的房产，需要前往<red>「莱昂置业」</>购买。
Description.LocalizedString: To own property in Hethereau, visit <red>Leon Estate Group</>.

Description.SourceString: 售房员了解当下城市所有的房产信息，选择心仪的房产签订购房合同即可购买。
Description.LocalizedString: Real estate agents have all the latest listings. Choose your desired property and sign the contract.

Description.SourceString: 名下所有的房产信息都会在地图上特别标注。
Description.LocalizedString: Your properties will be marked on the map.

Description.SourceString: 街上在售的商铺均可购买并用来开设商店。您也可以去<red>「莱昂置业」</>选购商铺。购买商铺后，您可以调整店内的雇员与商品来增加收入。调整商品后，不要忘了添加原料库存哦！
Description.LocalizedString: Shops for sale can be purchased to open your own store. Visit <red>Leon Estate Group</> to buy shops, then find the right employees and items to increase your revenue. Remember to keep inventory too!

Description.SourceString: 若您想拥有一辆自己的车辆，可以前往<red>「新越」</>车行进行挑选。
Description.LocalizedString: If you want to own a vehicle, you can head to <red>Novus</> and shop for one.

Description.SourceString: 通过<red>强化</>与<red>混频</>，可提升弧盘的各项属性，有效增强使用者的属性。
Description.LocalizedString: You can improve an Arc's attributes through <red>Enhancing</> and <red>Mixing</>, effectively boosting the wearer's stats.

Description.SourceString: 那些在旅途中与你结缘的伙伴，会时不时发来消息，分享他们所见所闻与生活点滴。
Description.LocalizedString: The companions you meet along your journey will occasionally send you messages, sharing what they've seen and heard, along with glimpses of their daily lives.

Description.SourceString: 除了通过进行正篇任务推动故事发展外，鉴定师还可以完成多样化的任务，更深入地体验世界的日常与变化。
Description.LocalizedString: In addition to progressing through Episodes, the Appraiser can complete quests to explore daily life and the world's evolving dynamics.

Description.SourceString:
「老大说贵重物品要装在这个保险箱里，我每次把钱装进去没多久就消失了了，这是什么物品传输异象吗……什么？这只是个普通的保险箱？啊？那我的钱呢？！」
粗心的成员会忘记给保险箱上锁，<red>将保险箱打开后能够获得一些贵重物品</>。不要对此有心理负担，这只是在学他们「收保护费」。
Description.LocalizedString:
"The boss said to put valuable stuff in this safe, but every time I put money in, it disappears soon after. Is this some kind of item teleportation Anomaly… What? This is just a regular safe? Huh? Then where's my money?!"
Careless members forget to lock their safes, so <red>opening these safes will net you some valuable items</>. Don't feel bad about it! You're just learning from them.

GuideName.SourceString: 附近发现城市违规行径

Title.SourceString: 附近发现城市违规行径

Description.SourceString:
在城市中，偶尔能看到他人的违规行径。
面对这些行径，你可以选择<red>上前制止、惩恶扬善，也可以将其无视</>——毕竟治安所可能会迟到，但不会缺席。
Description.LocalizedString:
Occasionally in the city, you may witness others breaking the rules.
When this happens, you can choose to <red>step in and stop them in the name of justice, or simply ignore it.</> After all, the Security Office may be late, but they will show up eventually.

Description.SourceString: 在异象追猎中，有一定概率遇到已结识的伙伴出手相助。伙伴会与你并肩作战，也会为你提供各种各样的帮助。
Description.LocalizedString: In Anomaly Hunt, you may encounter familiar companions who will assist and fight alongside you.

Description.SourceString: 在合适的时机释放<red>格挡</>能够<red>免疫伤害并减少「龙卷风」大量「倾陷值」</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Time <red>Block</> correctly to <red>negate damage and greatly reduce Tornado's Break</>.

Description.SourceString: 当「龙卷风」处于<red>倾陷状态</>，可对其使用<red>抱摔</>，造成<red>大量伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Use <red>Grapple Throw</> on the <red>Broken</> Tornado to deal <red>massive damage</>.

Description.SourceString:
在<red>限时时间</>内，四名参赛者自由战斗，根据淘汰的先后顺序决定最终排名。
若限时时间内未能产生冠军，则按所有参赛者的剩余生命值进行排名。
按照排名顺序，依次消耗 15、12、8、6 点「都市活力」，获得不同数量的「方斯」与「强效止疼片」。
无「都市活力」时仍可参赛，并按照排名获得「强效止疼片」。
参赛者的<red>耐力上限与大世界耐力上限保持一致</>。
Description.LocalizedString:
Four fighters enter the arena and battle <red>until time runs out</>. Final rankings are based on elimination order.
If no champion is crowned before the timer ends, rankings are based on each fighter's remaining HP.
Depending on your final rank, 15, 12, 8, or 6 City Stamina will be consumed, granting different amounts of Fons and Strong Painkillers.
You can still enter with no City Stamina. You will still earn Strong Painkillers based on your rank.
Your <red>Stamina cap in Fight Club matches your open-world Stamina cap</>.

Description.SourceString:
在「格斗俱乐部」中，参赛者禁止使用武器，赤手空拳进行较量。
鉴定师可以通过<red>普通攻击、重击、格挡、抱摔对抗敌人</>。
在淘汰敌人后，会进行<red>淘汰恢复</>，使自身血量获得一次恢复。
Description.LocalizedString:
Weapons are not allowed in Fight Club. Every match is fought bare-handed.
Use <red>Basic Attack, Heavy Attack, Block, and Grapple Throw to fight your opponents.</>.
<red>Elimination Recovery</>: Restores HP once whenever you eliminate an opponent.

Description.SourceString: 在战斗中还会出现特殊机制<red>肥皂</>和<red>松果炸弹</>，帮助鉴定师更快击败敌人。特殊机制的说明可以在<red>匹配界面</>中查看玩法说明
Description.LocalizedString: <red>Soap</> and <red>Pinecone Bomb</> can also appear during battle as special mechanics, helping you defeat opponents faster. View their details in the mode instructions on the <red>Matchmaking</> screen.

Description.SourceString:
真红是一位擅长<red>爆发</>的<red>输出角色</>。
真红在战斗中保持一段时间<red>不主动攻击</>可获得<red>「威慑凝视」</>，并随时间持续积攒层数；成功<red>极限闪避敌人攻击</>时，可额外获得<red>「威慑凝视」</>层数。
主动发动攻击会消耗<red>「威慑凝视」</>，触发<red>「即瞬猛袭」</>，造成额外伤害。
<red>普通攻击</>可积攒<red>「极轨终结：沸血赤红」</>能量。
释放<red>极轨终结</>后进入强化状态<red>「升腾之赤」</>，期间普通攻击与技能将强化替换，并可通过<red>普通攻击</>积攒技能能量，释放更多强化技能与专属<red>极轨终结</>。
Description.LocalizedString:
Shinku is a <red>Burst</>-focused <red>DMG dealer</>.
While in combat, if Shinku does <red>not initiate attacks</> for a period of time, she gains <red>Menacing Gaze</> and continuously builds stacks. Successfully performing a <red>Critical Dodge against enemy attacks</> grants additional <red>Menacing Gaze</> stacks.
When Shinku actively launches an attack, she consumes <red>Menacing Gaze</> to trigger <red>Instant Strike</>, dealing extra DMG.
Using <red>Basic Attack</> builds Energy for <red>Crimson Fury</>.
After casting <red>Ultimate</>, Shinku enters the enhanced state <red>Surging Crimson</>, replacing her Basic Attack and Skills with enhanced versions. During Surging Crimson, she can build Skill Energy through <red>Basic Attack</>, allowing her to unleash more enhanced Skills and her exclusive <red>Ultimate</>.

Description.SourceString:
伊洛伊是一位兼具<red>持续输出</>与<red>团队支援</>能力的<red>生存型角色</>。
普通攻击命中敌人后可以积攒<red>「臆想」</>。
长按<red>普通攻击</>可以释放分支攻击，消耗<red>「臆想」</>召唤小羊协助战斗；释放<red>技能</>期间长按普攻，分支攻击会直接召唤最大数量的小羊。
点按<red>技能</>可以回复全队生命值，长按<red>技能</>则会使除自己外的队友进入<red>「退行」</>状态，化身小羊协助战斗。
当<red>「臆想」</>达到一定值后，释放<red>极轨终结</>会开启<red>「象牙门的梦境」</>，持续对范围内敌人造成伤害，长按对应头像可复活一名处于<red>「退行」</>状态的队友。
Description.LocalizedString:
Iroi is a <red>Survival Character</> who provides both <red>sustained DMG</> and <red>team support</>.
Basic Attacks build <red>Imagination</> when they hit enemies.
Hold <red>Basic Attack</> to unleash a Branch Attack, consuming <red>Imagination</> to summon lambs that assist in battle. Hold Basic Attack while using <red>Skill</> to make the Branch Attack immediately summon the maximum number of lambs.
Press <red>Skill</> to restore all team members’ HP. Hold <red>Skill</> to put all team members except Iroi into <red>Regression</>, transforming them into lamb that assist in battle.
Once <red>Imagination</> reaches a certain amount, casting <red>Ultimate</> activates <red>Dream of the Ivory Gate</>, continuously dealing DMG to enemies in the area. Hold the corresponding avatar to revive 1 ally in <red>Regression</>.

Description.SourceString: 在篝火处可以使用【休整】【鉴定装备】【回收装备】【仓库】等功能，还可以通过地图传送至点燃的篝火处。
Description.LocalizedString: Bonfires allow you to rest, identify equipment, salvage equipment, access the Warehouse, and use other features. You can also use the Map to teleport to lit Bonfires.

Description.SourceString: 获得的「未鉴定装备」可以在「鉴定绵」处消耗「沃伦金币」进行鉴定。
Description.LocalizedString: Unidentified Equipment you obtain can be identified by Appraisal Fuzzy using Warren Gold Coins.

Description.SourceString:
在对局中，共有三块信息展示区域需要留意：

1.左侧：玩家信息列表
用于展示玩家的<red>历史出价记录</>和<red>仪器使用记录</>；
2.中间：情报显示板
用于展示当前已获得的<red>情报信息</>；
3.右侧：藏品仓库视图
用于展示当前已获知的<red>藏品信息</>。
Description.LocalizedString:
During each match, keep an eye on these three panels:

1. Left: Player List
Shows each player's <red>bid history</> and <red>device usage</>.
2. Center: Intel Panel
Shows all <red>intel</> you have gathered.
3. Right: Collectibles Warehouse
Shows all known <red>collectible details</>.

Description.SourceString: 玩家信息列表中，将显示玩家在前几回合使用过的<red>仪器</>及<red>历史出价记录</>。点击仪器图标或竞拍帮手头像，可以查看详细历史信息。
Description.LocalizedString: The Player List shows the <red>devices</> each player used and the <red>bids</> they placed in previous rounds. Click a device icon or an Auction Assistant portrait to view the full history.

Description.SourceString:
1.展示藏品的<red>轮廓</>时，对应位置将显示灰色的矩形块。
2.展示藏品的<red>品质</>时，将显示其中一格的品质颜色。
3.同时展示藏品的<red>轮廓与品质</>时，对应位置将出现带有流光特效的矩形块。
Description.LocalizedString:
1. When a collectible's <red>silhouette</> is revealed, a gray block appears in the corresponding slot.
2. When a collectible's <red>rarity</> is revealed, one section displays the matching rarity color.
3. When both its <red>silhouette and rarity</> are revealed, the corresponding slot appears with a shimmering effect.

Description.SourceString: 当不确定该如何出价时，可以点按藏品仓库视图中的<red>已知信息</>唤出藏品图鉴，利用自动筛选的结果进行鉴定；也可以参考当前估价作为依据。在犹豫不决时，与竞拍对手出相近的价格，也不失为一种可行的策略。
Description.LocalizedString: Not sure how much to bid? Click any <red>known intel</> in the Collectibles Warehouse to open the Collectibles Index. Its automatic filters will help narrow down the possibilities. You can also use the current estimated value as a guide. When in doubt, matching your opponents' bids can be a viable strategy.

Description.SourceString: 竞拍场总是风起云涌。请善用选定的仪器组合，并多多观察其他对手的动向，随时调整自己的决策。若对手突然一反常态，做出出人意料的举动，或许是收获了某些意想不到的信息。
Description.LocalizedString: The tide of an auction can turn at any moment. Make good use of your selected Device Set, watch your opponents closely, and adjust your strategy as needed. If an opponent suddenly acts out of character, they may have uncovered valuable new intel.

Description.SourceString: 在宝船拍卖会，你的核心目标是通过精明的竞拍获取更多金贝铢，不断积累你的财富。在竞拍中获得的藏品，将存入你的藏品仓库。
Description.LocalizedString: In the Treasure Ship Auction, your goal is to build your fortune by bidding wisely and earning more Gold Shells. Any collectibles you win will be added to your Collectibles Warehouse.

Description.SourceString: 要想在竞拍中占据优势，必须选择合适的竞拍帮手与仪器组合。不同的竞拍帮手各有其优势领域，而在仪器组合的辅助下，往往能获得意想不到的有利信息。
Description.LocalizedString: To gain an edge at auction, choose the right Auction Assistant and Device Set. Each Auction Assistant has their own specialty, while Device Sets can uncover valuable intel that may turn the auction in your favor.

Description.SourceString: 当处于破产边缘时，可点击低保金按钮领取低保金，重新投入竞拍。每日最多领取5次。
Description.LocalizedString: When you are on the verge of bankruptcy, click the Safety Fund button to receive emergency funds and get back in the game. The Safety Fund can be claimed up to 5 times per day.

Description.SourceString: 此刻，你已经成功完成了一次竞拍。原本神秘的藏品将一件件展示给所有玩家，并公布中拍者的盈亏情况。如果中拍者亏损，其他三名玩家将获得其亏损金额10%的金贝铢作为奖励金。
Description.LocalizedString: You've completed your first auction! The mystery collectibles will now be revealed one by one, along with the winner's profit or loss. If the winner suffers a loss, each of the other three players receives a bonus equal to 10% of that loss.

GuideName.SourceString: 「即刻落槌」藏品仓库与展览柜
GuideName.LocalizedString: Going, Going, Gone! Collectibles Warehouse & Display Case

Title.SourceString: 「即刻落槌」藏品仓库与展览柜
Title.LocalizedString: Going, Going, Gone! Collectibles Warehouse & Display Case

Description.SourceString: 藏品仓库中存放着你在对局中成功拍下的所有藏品。你可以将藏品变卖，以获取更多竞拍资金；也可以将心仪的顶级藏品放入展览柜，尽情欣赏你的战利品，同时从中赚取展览收益。
Description.LocalizedString: The Collectibles Warehouse holds every collectible you have won at auction. Sell them to gain more bidding funds, or place your favorite high-value pieces in the Display Case to admire your prizes and earn income over time.

Description.SourceString:
"残虹是一位擅长<red>持续输出</>的<red>输出角色</>。
释放<red>变轨技能</>可以在<red>「现实状态」</>与<red>「幻境状态」</>之间切换。现实状态擅长造成高额直接伤害；幻境状态则能够施加<red>持续伤害</>，并将持续伤害扩散至周围敌人。
在<red>幻境状态</>下，可通过<red>变轨技能</>激活<red>幻境极轨终结</>。
当激活<red>幻境极轨终结</>且现实极轨终结处于可释放状态时，可连续释放<red>幻境极轨终结</>与强化<red>现实极轨终结</>，打出高额爆发伤害。"
Description.LocalizedString:
Zankou is a <red>DMG Dealer</> who excels at <red>sustained damage</>.
Cast the <red>Redirect Skill</> to switch between <red>Reality Form</> and <red>Illusion Form</>. In Reality Form, she excels at dealing high Direct DMG, while in Illusion Form she inflicts <red>DoT</> and spreads it to nearby enemies.
While in <red>Illusion Form</>, cast the <red>Redirect Skill</> to enable the <red>Illusion Form Ultimate</>.
When the <red>Illusion Form Ultimate</> is enabled and the Reality Form Ultimate is ready, cast the <red>Illusion Form Ultimate</> followed by an enhanced <red>Reality Form Ultimate</> to deal massive Burst DMG.

Description.SourceString:
灵可是一位擅长<red>协同作战</>的<red>输出角色</>。
普通攻击和<red>极限闪避反击</>可以积攒<red>「谐频」</>，普攻过程中长按<red>普通攻击</>可触发分支<red>「普通攻击：恶灵大巴掌！」」</>。
释放<red>「变轨技能：瞬息全频振」</>时，灵可能够选择队友或小贞发动「同频合击」，并消耗<red>「谐频」</>提升<red>「同频合击」</>造成的伤害。
灵可位于后台时，每隔8秒小贞会攻击敌人并施加<red>「小鬼打这里！」</>标记；前台角色使用变轨技能击碎标记后，可触发灵可的<red>「同频合击」</>。
释放<red>「极轨终结：超负荷共鸣」</>，灵可进入持续一定时间的异能过载状态，并展开持续一定时间的「共鸣领域」，可连续发动至多3次队友的<red>「同频合击」</>；等待异能过载状态结束、或者点按「极轨终结：超负荷共鸣」提前结束，灵可对「共鸣领域」内的敌方单位造成灵属性异能伤害，目标携带的负面状态越多，造成的伤害越高。
Description.LocalizedString:
Linko is a <red>DMG dealer</> who specializes in <red>coordinated attacks</>.
Use Basic Attacks and <red>Critical Ripostes</> to build up<red> Modulation Points</>. Hold <red>Basic Attack</> to trigger the Branch Attack <red>Spectral Smack</>.
When Linko casts <red>Full-Frequency Pulse</>, select an ally or Xiaozhen to perform a Synced Strike. <red>Modulation Points</> are consumed to increase the damage dealt by the <red>Synced Strike</>.
While Linko is off-field, Xiaozhen attacks enemies every 8s and applies the <red>Hit 'Em Here!</> mark. When the active character breaks the mark with a Redirect Skill, Linko performs a <red>Synced Strike</>.
After casting <red>Oversync</>, Linko enters Overdrive and summons a Resonance Field for a set duration, allowing allies to perform up to 3 <red>Synced Strikes</>. When Overdrive expires or Oversync is pressed again, Linko deals Anima DMG to enemies within Resonance Field. This DMG increases based on the number of different debuffs on the target.

Description.SourceString: 沉没的货船在海中散落了大量的货物，如果看到海上有漂浮物，就尝试靠近回收吧！越是靠近货船，越有可能获得高价值漂浮物。
Description.LocalizedString: The sunken cargo ship has scattered cargo all across the sea. If you spot Floating Cargo, get close and salvage it! The nearer you are to the cargo ship, the more likely you are to find high-value Floating Cargo.

Description.SourceString: 进入瞄准状态后，即可发射鱼叉枪，如果在鱼叉的最大可拖动重量内，即可成功回收。如果觉得无法瞄准，可以适当降低摩托艇速度。
Description.LocalizedString: Once you enter Aiming Mode, you can fire the Harpoon Gun. Targets within its maximum towing capacity can be successfully salvaged. If you're having trouble aiming, try slowing down your Jet Ski.

Description.SourceString: 经过特殊改装的回收用摩托艇需要消耗能源驾驶，能源条上的浮动指示标将指出危险的能源范围，如果能源跌落到浮动指示标以下，需要立刻考虑返航或是在海面上寻找能源补给箱。
