Description.LocalizedString: The specially modified salvage Jet Ski consumes energy while in use. The moving marker on the Energy Bar shows the danger threshold. If your energy falls below it, head back immediately or look for Power Crates on the water.

Description.SourceString: 当在海上回收到漂浮物后，需返回登陆点进行交货结算，从海中还能获得升级用的素材，提升摩托艇和鱼叉枪的性能。
Description.LocalizedString: After salvaging Floating Cargo, return to the landing point to turn in your haul. You can also find upgrade materials at sea to improve your Jet Ski and Harpoon Gun.

Description.SourceString:
"黑羽是一位既能<red>协同作战</>也能通过释放<red>极轨终结</>进入悬浮状态后，进行<red>强力输出</>的角色。
基础形态下，<red>普通攻击 </>、<red>下落攻击 </>、<red>闪避反击 </>、<red>弹刀 </> 与<red>技能 </> 命中敌人可积攒<red>「恶意」</>。
黑羽为<red>即瞬环合 </> 角色，释放<red>变轨技能 </> 后瞬间充满<red>环合值 </>，并为目标施加<red>「失乐羽」</>；切换队友攻击可触发<red>「失乐鸟」协同攻击 </>。
释放<red>极轨终结 </> 后化身<red>「救世的魔女」 </>，普攻与技能全部更换，黑羽在<red>「救世的魔女」 </>状态下造成伤害时将消耗<red>「恶意」</> 造成额外伤害。
<red>「救世的魔女」 </>状态下<red>「变轨技能：渡世死焰」 </>初始未激活，<red>「普通攻击：祭火」第五段 </> 或承轨反击<red>「无悲」 </> 后可激活，使用后恢复未激活；再次释放<red>「极轨终结：万火归一」 </> 可恢复至原本形态。"
Description.LocalizedString:
Blackbird excels at both <red>coordinated attacks</> and <red>high DMG output</>. After casting her <red>Ultimate</> and entering Hover, she can unleash powerful attacks.
In her base form, hitting enemies with <red>Basic Attacks</>, <red>Plunging Attacks</>, <red>Critical Ripostes</>, <red>Parries</>, or <red>Skills</> builds <red>Malice</>.
Blackbird is an <red>Instant Cycle</> character. Casting a <red>Redirect Skill</> instantly fills her <red>Cycle Energy</> and applies <red>Forsaken Feather</> to the target. Switch to a teammate and attack to trigger a <red>Forsaken Bird coordinated attack</>.
After casting her <red>Ultimate</>, Blackbird transforms into the <red>Witch of Deliverance</>, gaining a new set of Basic Attacks and Skills. In the <red>Witch of Deliverance</> state, she consumes <red>Malice</> when dealing DMG to inflict additional DMG.
While in the <red>Witch of Deliverance</> state, <red>Flames of Deliverance</> is initially inactive. Land the 5th hit of <red>Pyreflame</> or use the Parry Attack <red>No Quarter</> to activate it. Flames of Deliverance becomes inactive after being used. Cast <red>Flammae in Unum</> again to return to Blackbird's base form.

Description.SourceString:
明音凛是一位擅长根据场上敌人的数量灵活调整攻势的<red>输出角色</>。
普通攻击命中敌人时会积攒<red>「弦能」</>，<red>「弦能」</>充满后，技能会根据当前状态强化为对应的<red>引爆</>。 
点按「变轨技能：律动音浪」可为目标附着<red>「泛音列」</>，持续压制单个敌人；长按「变轨技能：律动音浪」可展开<red>「音域」</>，同时攻击多个敌人。
<red>「泛音列」</>与<red>「音域」</>不能同时存在，普通攻击会根据当前状态，将伤害传导至附着有「泛音列」的敌人或<red>「音域」</>内的敌人。 
<red>「弦能」</>充满后释放强化技能<red>「同调共振」</>，可引爆「泛音列」对单体造成高额伤害，或引爆<red>「音域」</>对范围内敌人造成扩散伤害。 
释放「极轨终结：音障爆鸣」会先造成第一段伤害并进入<red>华彩连段</>状态，<red>华彩连段</>持续时间过半后可释放第二段「极轨终结：音障爆鸣」对敌人造成伤害。
Description.LocalizedString:
Akane Rin is a <red>DMG dealer</> who can adapt her attacks based on the number of enemies on the field.
Hitting enemies with Basic Attacks builds <red>String Energy</>. When <red>String Energy</> is full, her Skill is enhanced into the corresponding <red>Detonation</> based on her current state.
Press Rhythm Wave to apply <red>Overtone</> to a target and focus on a single enemy. Hold Rhythm Wave to create a <red>Reverb Field</> and attack multiple enemies at once.
<red>Overtone</> and <red>Reverb Field</> do not coexist. Depending on her current state, Basic Attacks transmit DMG to the enemy affected by Overtone or to enemies within the <red>Reverb Field</>.
When <red>String Energy</> is full, cast the enhanced skill <red>Synced Resonance</> to detonate Overtone for heavy single-target DMG, or detonate the <red>Reverb Field</> to deal Spread DMG to enemies within it.
Casting Sonic Boom launches its first instance and puts Akane into the <red>Solo Cadenza</> state. Once <red>Solo Cadenza</> is past its halfway point, Akane Rin can cast the second instance of Sonic Boom to deal DMG to enemies.

Description.SourceString:
在甜蜜大摆圈中，只需点击对应方向键，击中对应的圆圈，即可获得分数。
圆圈分为单点\长按\连点三类，注意颜色区分。
粉色糖圈：单次点击
蓝色糖圈：长按点击
橙色糖圈：连续点击
Description.LocalizedString:
In the Punchulum Ride, press the corresponding Movement key when each circle appears to earn points.
There are three types of inputs: press, hold, and repeated press. Watch the colors carefully to know which one to use.
Pink Candy Ring: Press once
Blue Candy Ring: Hold
Orange Candy Ring: Press repeatedly

Description.SourceString:
过程中失误的话会积累角色的恐惧值，成功则会消解恐惧值。恐惧值过高的话，会以低评分提前结束游戏。
多次完美击中的话，将会开启特殊的挑战关卡，挑战成功即可进入特殊结局，请努力挑战吧。
Description.LocalizedString:
Mistakes increase your character's Fear, while successful inputs reduce it. If Fear gets too high, the game will end early and you'll receive a low rating.
Land multiple Perfects to unlock a special challenge stage. Clear it to reach the special ending. Give it your best shot!

Description.SourceString:
在糖仙子圆舞会中，绿色光标移动到按键正中时点击对应方向，即可根据判定结果积攒火力值一次。
根据点击时机的准确度，判定分为<red>「完美」「普通」「失败」</>。
Description.LocalizedString:
In Pixies Waltz, press the corresponding direction when the green cursor reaches the center of the button to build Firepower.
Your timing will be rated <red>Perfect, Normal, or Miss</>.

Description.SourceString:
抵达塔顶后将进入第一人称射击模式，消耗火力努力击中空中的糖果，获得得分吧！
单次游玩中，有<red>一半</>积攒火力值判定为<red>「完美」</>的话，将会开启特殊的挑战关卡，挑战成功即可进入特殊结局，请努力挑战吧。
Description.LocalizedString:
Reach the top of the tower to enter first-person shooting mode. Spend Firepower to shoot down airborne candy and earn points!
If <red>half</> of the Firepower you gain in a single run is earned with a <red>Perfect</> rating, a special challenge stage will unlock. Clear it to reach the special ending. Give it your best shot!

Description.SourceString:
在八爪转转杯中，点击对应方向键旋转视角，长按射击键释放弹药，灵活切换炮弹与叉子两种道具应对危机。
炮弹可击退来袭的八爪鱼触角，守护转转杯的耐久值；叉子可获取宝箱与藏宝图，获得分数！但需要注意的是，若转转杯的耐久值归零，会以低评分提前结束游戏。
Description.LocalizedString:
In Candy Jar Raid, press the corresponding Movement keys to rotate your view, and hold the Shoot key to fire. Switch between Cannonballs and Forks depending on the situation.
Use Cannonballs to knock back approaching octopus tentacles and protect the cup's Durability. Use Forks to collect Treasure Chests and Treasure Maps for points. Be careful—if the cup's Durability reaches zero, the game will end early with a low rating.

Description.SourceString:
若遇到被强力触手抓住的情况,需要及时击退额外来袭触手,避免扣除大量分数与耐久值。
集齐所有宝藏图，将会解锁专属挑战关卡，击退所有黄金触手挑战成功即可进入特殊结局，请努力挑战吧。
Description.LocalizedString:
If a powerful tentacle grabs you, quickly repel the other attacking tentacles to avoid losing a large amount of points and durability.
Collect all Treasure Maps to unlock a special challenge stage. Defeat all Golden Tentacles to clear the challenge and unlock a special ending. Give it your all!

Description.SourceString: 在熔岩镇淘金热中，使用方向键与跳跃键操控矿车切换至相邻轨道躲避沿途障碍，拾取枪械道具击打对应障碍物、收集金币来获取分数。
Description.LocalizedString: In Lavaton Gold Rush, use the Movement and Jump keys to control the mine cart. Switch between adjacent tracks to dodge obstacles, pick up weapons to destroy them, and collect coins to earn points.

Description.SourceString:
矿车飞跃时可左右调整落地轨道，但遭遇岩浆喷发时将会受到限制，行驶至陡峭轨道则需按下加速键奋力爬升。
若是撞上障碍物或是矿车脱离轨道等行为导致扣分过多，会以低评分提前结束游戏。
Description.LocalizedString:
While airborne, you can steer the mine cart left or right to choose which track to land on, though your movement will be limited during lava eruptions. On steep tracks, press the Speed Up key to make it up the slope.
Hitting obstacles or derailing will cost you points. Lose too many points, and the game will end early with a low score.

Description.SourceString:
在花篱秘密园中，玩家将在迷宫随机点位出生，每一局迷宫布局都会随机组合。
自由探索迷宫场景，寻找随机刷新的出口顺利逃离，收集所有散落的扑克牌、并解救所有受困的噗仔即可收获对应奖励。
Description.LocalizedString:
In Flora Maze, players spawn at random locations, and the maze layout changes each round.
Explore the maze, find the exit, and escape! Collect all the scattered playing cards and rescue every trapped Pukaboo to earn additional rewards.

Description.SourceString:
使用棒棒眼镜时可以显示出口位置，但会加快探索时间流逝；拾取不同的道具，可额外增加对应挑战时长。靠近特殊灌木能够解锁隐藏通路，部分灌木还会自主移动。
未能在规定时间内逃离迷宫，会以低评分结束游戏。请努力进行探索吧。
Description.LocalizedString:
Lollipop Goggles reveal the location of the exit, but also make the timer run faster. Pick up other items to gain more time. Approach special bushes to uncover hidden paths—but be careful, some bushes move on their own!
If you fail to escape before time runs out, the challenge will end early with a low rating. Good luck out there!

Description.SourceString:
在趣奇诡乐屋中，以第一人称视角探索闯关，依靠特质手电筒找到开启出口的办法，逃离这里吧。
手电筒在使用时会持续消耗电量，并支持切换照明模式。
紫光灯模式耗电速度较快，可显露隐身鬼管家与隐藏机关；消耗一定电量则可以触发一次强力闪光，能够短暂眩晕大部分鬼管家，闪光还可与屋内的特定机关产生特殊作用，强力闪光短时间内无法重复使用。
Description.LocalizedString:
Explore Spooky Cookies in first person and use your special flashlight to find a way to unlock the exit and escape.
The flashlight drains battery power while in use and has several lighting modes.
UV mode drains the battery faster, but reveals hidden Ghost Butlers and concealed mechanisms. You can also consume some battery power to unleash a powerful flash that briefly stuns most Ghost Butlers. The flash can activate certain mechanisms around the house as well, but has a short cooldown.

Description.SourceString: 电量耗尽或受到鬼管家惊吓，会累积惊吓值，一旦惊吓值涨满，将会以低评分结束游戏。鬼屋内可以找到电池和理智喷雾，分别用于恢复电量和降低惊吓值。
Description.LocalizedString: Running out of battery power or getting scared by a Ghost Butler increases your Fright. If Fright reaches its maximum, the game will end with a low rating. Look for Batteries to restore battery power and Courage Spray to reduce Fright.

Description.SourceString: 在噗仔叠叠乐中，枪械设施会自动左右往复移动，长按射击键进行蓄力，瞄准后松开按键发射炮弹击倒罐头来争取更多分数吧。
Description.LocalizedString: In Pukaboo Stack, the gun platform moves left and right automatically. Hold the Shoot key to charge your shot, aim carefully, then release it to fire and knock down cans for points.

Description.SourceString:
在秘密对对碰挑战中，记住罐子下方藏有的道具，以两两配对的形式，找出相同道具完成匹配。
若是限定时间内没能完成所有匹配，会以时间结束时的当前评分结算。开动你的记忆全力闯关吧。
Description.LocalizedString:
In the Secret Match challenge, memorize the items hidden under the jars, then match identical items in pairs.
Match all the pairs before time runs out. Otherwise, your rating when time runs out becomes your final result. Put your memory to the test and give it your all!

Description.SourceString: 在魔法幸运盘中，只需支付噗卡星票即可转动转盘，有机会赢取更多噗卡星票回报，快来试试你的运气吧。
Description.LocalizedString: In The Magic Spin, spend Puka Stars to spin the wheel for a chance to win even more Puka Stars. Try your luck!

Description.SourceString:
在捣蛋鬼集合里，限定时间内击打从洞口冒出的噗仔来获取分数。
击中特殊噗仔可以收获更多分数，击中松果炸弹会扣除分数。
若是击中打击锤子，场上所有噗仔便会被一并击退。
Description.LocalizedString:
In Whack-a-Puka, hit Pukaboos as they pop out of their holes to score points before time runs out.
Some special Pukaboos are worth more points, but hitting a Pinecone Bomb will cost you points.
Hit the Bonk Hammer to knock back all Pukaboos on the field.

Description.SourceString:
在命中幸运星中，操控准星对抗随机晃动的外力，把握最佳时机射出飞镖，争取拿下更高分数。
飞镖落在双倍区获得数字双倍分数，三倍区获得数字三倍分数，单倍区结算基础数字分数。
外中心圆固定 25 分，红心固定拿下 50 分。
Description.LocalizedString:
In Star-Struck, the crosshair sways unpredictably. Time your throw carefully and land your dart in a high-scoring area.
Darts that land in the double ring score twice the segment value, while darts in the triple ring score three times the segment value. Darts in single areas score the base value.
The outer bull is always worth 25 points, while the bullseye is worth 50.

Description.SourceString:
在玩偶大作战中，射出弹药击倒不断移动的玩偶来赚取更多分数。
紧盯目标，把握时机完成射击，尽可能累积更高的得分，全力展开射击挑战吧。
Description.LocalizedString:
In Plushie Shootout, shoot the moving dolls to knock them down and score points.
Keep your eyes on the targets, time your shots carefully, and rack up as many points as you can. Take aim and go for the high score!

Description.SourceString:
在糖果转台中，灵活切换合适弹药完成射击来积累分数。
拥有珍珠与星星两类弹药可供切换。当贝壳张开时，射出珍珠即可赚取积分；贝壳紧闭时，射出星星能够将贝壳重新开启。
此外转台还可以切换旋转方向，选对弹药和策略，争取多多得分吧。
Description.LocalizedString:
In Candy Carousel, switch between Pearl and Star ammo to rack up points.
Use Pearl ammo while the shell is open to score points. When it closes, use Star ammo to open it again.
You can also reverse the carousel's direction. Choose the right ammo and strategy to score as many points as possible.

Description.SourceString:
初到噗卡乐园，你将会获得一本奇遇收藏册。
打开收藏册可以接取各式各样的乐园打卡任务，完成后便能领取噗卡星票等丰厚奖励。
前往对应项目的售票员处，即可打卡点亮手册里的游乐项目。
Description.LocalizedString:
When you first arrive at Pukaland, you'll receive a Wonderlog.
Open it to take on Check-In Quests and earn rewards, including Puka Stars.
Visit each attraction's ticket seller to check in and light up its entry in your Wonderlog.

Description.SourceString:
消耗方斯游玩项目，还会依据游玩评分结算噗卡星票。
积攒的噗卡星票，可以前往噗卡大街的星票小铺，兑换各类精美奖赏。快来填满你的收藏册吧。
Description.LocalizedString:
You can also spend Fons to play attractions and earn Puka Stars based on your score.
Take your Puka Stars to the Star Ticket Counter on Puka Street and redeem them for all kinds of fabulous rewards. Fill up your Wonderlog and make the most of your trip to Pukaland!

Description.SourceString:
1.移动<red>准星</>透过掩体缝隙瞄准对手，点击<red>射击按钮</>可开火。
2.射击可<red>破坏掩体</>，打开视野。
3.每轮最多射击<red>3次</>，命中对手、子弹耗尽或超时即结束本轮；若比赛尚未结束，将<red>切换射击方</>。
Description.LocalizedString:
1. Move the <red>reticle</> to aim at your opponent through openings in the cover, then press the <red>Fire button</> to shoot.
2. Shots can <red>destroy cover</>, opening up your line of sight.
3. You can fire up to <red>3 shots</> per round. The round ends when you hit your opponent, use all 3 shots, or time runs out. If the match is not over, the players <red>swap roles</>.

Description.SourceString:
1.<red>红色射线</>表示对方的瞄准方向。
2.观察射线位置，在限定范围内<red>左右移动</>进行躲避。
3.可使用右下方的<red>动作按钮</>切换姿态，利用掩体遮挡身体、保护弱点，躲避对手的射击。
Description.LocalizedString:
1. The <red>red aiming laser</> shows where your opponent is aiming.
2. Watch the laser and <red>move left and right</> within the designated area to dodge incoming shots.
3. Use the <red>Action button</> in the bottom-right corner to switch stances. Use cover to keep as much of your body hidden as possible, protect your Weak Point, and avoid incoming shots.

Description.SourceString:
大量怪物将持续对炭团发起进攻，保护炭团的宝藏。
每只怪物都会在炭团的范围内造成持续伤害，不同怪物的攻击还将造成额外伤害。
鉴定师需要通过灵活使用道具，合理分配增益，一人成军，阻止怪物。
Description.LocalizedString:
Enemies will attack Coal Lump in relentless waves. Protect Coal Lump's Treasure!
Each enemy deals damage over time while within Coal Lump's range, and certain enemies can deal additional damage.
Use items strategically, choose your buffs wisely, and stand your ground against the horde.

Title.LocalizedString: Coal Lump Coins & Coal Lump HP

Description.SourceString:
每次击败怪物时，将掉落一定数量的【炭团币】。
【炭团币】可前往贩卖机兑换道具。
炭团会随着收到伤害的积累，减少血量。
当炭团血量降低至0时，炭团将自爆，同时结算本局游戏。
Description.LocalizedString:
Defeated enemies drop a certain number of Coal Lump Coins.
Spend Coal Lump Coins at vending machines to redeem items.
Coal Lump loses HP whenever it takes damage.
When Coal Lump's HP reaches 0, it self-destructs, immediately ending the run and calculating your final results.

Description.SourceString:
场地的四周，设置有道具贩卖机。
鉴定师可花费怪物掉落的【炭团币】兑换道具。
道具只能同时拥有一个，额外拾取的道具将自动替换当前道具。
Description.LocalizedString:
Item Vending Machines are located around the arena.
Spend Coal Lump Coins dropped by enemies to redeem items.
You can hold only one item at a time. Picking up another item automatically replaces your current item.

Description.SourceString:
道具拥有强大的效果。
例如：燃烧、冰冻、减速 ......
合理使用道具，搭配不同增益可以达到意想不到的效果。
Description.LocalizedString:
Items provide powerful effects.
Examples include Burn, Freeze, Slow…
Use items wisely and combine them with different buffs to create powerful synergies.

Description.SourceString:
游戏过程中，可以随时暂停游戏。
鉴定师可以选择【退出并保存】，保存已完成的波次，以便下次游玩。
也可以选择【退出并结算】，立即结算当前游戏，获取对应奖励。
注意：请在游戏开始后，再退出。
Description.LocalizedString:
You can pause the game at any time.
Select Quit & Save to save your completed waves and resume from there next time.
You can also select Quit & Settle to end the current run immediately and receive the corresponding rewards.
Note: Quit options are only available after the run has started.

Description.SourceString:
怪物将在有限的波次中不断进攻。
不同波次的怪物，会拥有不同特殊能力。
以上是基础教程
那么，开始保护炭团的宝藏吧！
Description.LocalizedString:
Enemies will attack across a limited number of waves.
Each wave features enemies with different special abilities.
That's all for the basics.
Now go protect Coal Lump's Treasure!

Description.SourceString:
曳尔沐是一位能通过增强<red>「信号强度」</>强化自身战斗能力，并为队友提供<red>攻击提升</>与<red>后台协同攻击</>的角色。
曳尔沐的<red>「信号强度」</>共有三级。处于<red>「弱信号」</>状态时，使用五段普通攻击，释放<red>普攻第五段</>或<red>基础技能「离去的人们」</>后可激活<red>强化技能「不连续的存在」</>；入战时，强化技能「不连续的存在」直接处于可施放状态。
释放<red>基础技能「离去的人们」</>可瞬间充满<red>环合能量</>；释放<red>强化技能「不连续的存在」</>或<red>援护技</>可使曳尔沐的信号强度从<red>「弱信号」</>提升至<red>「中等信号」</>，并获得一层增益效果<red>「错视幻觉」</>。
<red>「中等信号」或「强信号」状态</>下，普通攻击变为三段，释放<red>普攻第三段</>后可激活<red>进阶强化技能「对你说再见」</>。释放进阶强化技能可增强至<red>「强信号」状态</>，并消耗全部<red>「错视幻觉」</>层数，提高本次技能的伤害倍率。
释放<red>强化技能和进阶强化技能</>或释放<red>援护技</>时会检索周围敌人数量，决定极轨终结的<red>对单或对群形态</>；在<red>「弱信号」</>状态释放极轨终结时，默认使用对群形态。
释放<red>极轨终结</>后，为其他队友提供<red>攻击提升</>，并获得<red>「后台连线」</>状态。切换至队友后，曳尔沐会根据大招形态及释放时的信号强度自动进行<red>协同攻击</>，该伤害视为<red>追加攻击</>。
Description.LocalizedString:
Elyms strengthens her combat abilities by increasing her <red>Connection Strength</>. She also grants allies <red>ATK Bonuses</> and performs <red>off-field coordinated attacks</>.
Elyms has three <red>Connection Strength</> levels. At <red>Weak Connection</>, she performs a five-instance Basic Attack combo. Performing the <red>fifth instance</> or casting <red>The Ones Who Left</> activates <red>Intermittent Existence</>, which is also available at the start of combat.
Casting <red>The Ones Who Left</> instantly fills <red>Cycle Energy</> to maximum. Casting <red>Intermittent Existence</> or a <red>Support Skill</> raises her Connection Strength from <red>Weak Connection</> to <red>Medium Connection</> and grants 1 stack of <red>Optical Illusion</>.
At <red>Medium Connection or Strong Connection</>, her Basic Attack combo has three instances. Performing the <red>third instance</> activates <red>Goodbye to You</>. Casting Goodbye to You raises her Connection Strength to <red>Strong Connection</> and consumes all <red>Optical Illusion</> stacks to increase the skill's DMG Ratio for that cast.
When casting <red>Intermittent Existence</>, <red>Goodbye to You</>, or the <red>Support Skill</>, she scans nearby enemies to determine whether her Ultimate uses its <red>single-target or AoE form</>. At <red>Weak Connection</>, the Ultimate defaults to its AoE form.
After casting her <red>Ultimate</>, Elyms grants the whole team an <red>ATK Bonus</> and enters the <red>On the Line</> state. Once you switch to another character, Elyms automatically performs a <red>coordinated attack</> while off-field, based on the Ultimate's form and her Connection Strength when it was cast. DMG dealt by this attack counts as <red>Follow-up Attack</> DMG.

Description.SourceString:
Exe是一位擅长<red>远程</>攻击的<red>输出角色</>。 
攻击命中敌人可积攒<red>「帧数」</>与<red>「评分」</>，<red>「评分」等级</>越高，<red>「帧数」</>的积攒速度越快；<red>普通攻击</>第5段与部分招式会消耗<red>「帧数」</>导出<red>「数字残像」</>协同攻击。
长按<red>普通攻击</>可发动<red>「普通攻击：纵深侵入」</>，重置普攻连段；
释放<red>变轨技能</>，可消耗大量<red>「帧数」</>导出多个<red>「数字残像」</>，快速提升<red>「评分」</>等级。
 释放<red>极轨终结</>后进入<red>「方程构建」</>状态，期间Exe的所有攻击均可消耗<red>「帧数」</>导出<red>「数字残像」</>。 
<red>「方程构建」</>持续期间，<red>「普通攻击：纵深侵入」</>可处决生命值低于一定比例的非Boss敌人，并延长<red>「方程构建」</>状态的持续时间。
Description.LocalizedString:
Exe is a <red>ranged</> <red>DMG dealer</>.
Hitting enemies generates <red>Frames</> and increases his <red>Rating</>. The higher his <red>Rating Level</>, the faster he gains <red>Frames</>. The fifth attack in his <red>Basic Attack</> combo and certain other moves consume <red>Frames</> to summon <red>Digital Echoes</> that perform coordinated attacks.
Hold <red>Basic Attack</> to perform <red>Network Penetration</> and reset his Basic Attack combo.
Casting his <red>Redirect Skill</> consumes a large number of <red>Frames</> to summon multiple <red>Digital Echoes</> and rapidly increase his <red>Rating Level</>.
Casting his <red>Ultimate</> puts Exe into the <red>Shader Compile</> state. While Shader Compile is active, all his attacks can consume <red>Frames</> to summon <red>Digital Echoes</>.
While <red>Shader Compile</> is active, his <red>Network Penetration</> can execute non-Boss enemies whose HP falls below a certain threshold. Executing an enemy extends the duration of <red>Shader Compile</>.

Description.SourceString:
当段位达到「职业Ⅳ」及以上时，比赛将启用进阶规则。

与好友组队时，只要队伍中任意一人达到「职业Ⅳ」及以上，整场比赛也将启用进阶规则。
Description.LocalizedString:
Advanced rules apply once you reach Professional IV.

When playing with friends, the entire match uses advanced rules if any teammate is Professional IV or higher.

Description.SourceString: 进阶比赛中，将不再显示排球的落点提示。仔细观察球的飞行轨迹，提前判断落点并移动接球。
Description.LocalizedString: In advanced volleyball matches, the landing indicator is hidden. Watch the ball's trajectory, anticipate where it will land, and move into position to receive it.

Description.SourceString: 接球、救球、拦网和扣球都会消耗体力。体力越低，角色的各项能力也会逐渐下降。每分结束后，所有角色的体力恢复至满值。
Description.LocalizedString: Receiving, digging, blocking, and spiking consume Stamina. As Stamina drops, characters become less effective. All characters regain full Stamina after each point.

Description.SourceString: 二传时，按住「左」或「右」并传球，即可将球传向对应方向。观察对方的防守站位，选择更有利的传球路线。
Description.LocalizedString: When setting, hold Left or Right to direct the ball. Watch the other team's positioning and choose the better passing lane.

Description.SourceString: 传球时，按住「上」可进行快传，按住「下」可进行慢传。还可以组合使用方向键，例如同时按住「右」和「下」传球，即可向右侧慢传。
Description.LocalizedString: When setting, hold Up for a quick set or Down for a slow set. Combine directions, such as Right + Down, to make a slow set to the right.

Description.SourceString: 空中轻扣时，不按方向键即可打出原有的吊球；按住「上」「下」「左」或「右」中的任意一个方向键，即可将球打向对应方向，灵活改变落点，避开对方防守。
Description.LocalizedString: When tipping in midair, use no directional input for a standard tip. Hold Up, Down, Left, or Right to aim the ball and get past defenders.

Description.SourceString: 即刻落槌玩法现已接入举报系统，在版本更新后请各位玩家遵守游戏规则。恶意多开、恶意挂机、频繁异常收入等游戏行为在被举报成功后将被封禁处理。具体的封禁时长视情结严重程度决定。
Description.LocalizedString: Player reporting is now available in Going, Going, Gone! Following this update, confirmed reports of abusing multiple game instances, deliberately going AFK, or repeatedly obtaining rewards through suspicious activity will result in bans. Ban durations depend on the severity of the violation.

GuideName.SourceString: 「即刻落槌」收藏展柜功能说明
GuideName.LocalizedString: Going, Going, Gone! — Collection Showcase Guide

Description.SourceString:
1.收藏展柜内存在大小不一的展位，可存放并展示玩家获得的高品质藏品。
2.部分藏品积累到指定数目，可兑换专属家具，用于装点居所。
3.每月兑换家具次数存在限制。
4.部分特殊都市特技会对兑换家具条件产生影响。
5.收藏展柜可花费金贝铢进行升级，升级将提升收藏展柜展示效果。
Description.LocalizedString:
1. The Collection Showcase has display slots of different sizes where you can store and display high-quality collectibles.
2. Collect the required number of certain collectibles to exchange them for exclusive furniture for your home.
3. Furniture exchanges are limited each month.
4. Certain Special Life Skills change the requirements for furniture exchanges.
5. Spend Gold Shell to upgrade the Collection Showcase and enhance its displays.
